rules: Iris is the Champion and she's literally a child. The whole table fights a kid. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Outrage. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: Beaten by a child. Everyone drinks 4 and apologizes to her. 7-19: You land one on a kid. The table boos you; give 4 anyway. 20-20: Natural 20! You send her to bed. Give 10. · Beat 2: Haxorus, and she's already crying. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Dragon Dance. Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: Dragon Dance. Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: You beat a kid. Give 6, ashamed. 20-20: Natural 20! You beat a kid. Give 12, ashamed.)

title: Diantha
rules: Diantha is a movie star. The whole table acts out a dramatic death, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Box-office flop. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: Moonblast. Everyone drinks 4; the worst death scene drinks 2 more. 7-19: An award-worthy hit. Thank the Academy, then give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Standing ovation. Give 10. · Beat 2: Her final scene. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She steals the scene. Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: She steals the scene. Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: Cut! That's a wrap. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! Cut! That's a wrap. Give 12.)

title: Professor Kukui
rules: Professor Kukui fights shirtless in a lab coat. The whole table yells "Woo!" Then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Lab coat to the face. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: Woo! Everyone drinks 3 and flexes. 7-19: A hit, cousin! Pick a cousin at the table; you both give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Woo! Give 10. · Beat 2: Incineroar, shirtless too. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Darkest Lariat. Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: Darkest Lariat. Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: Woo! Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! Woo! Give 12.)

title: Leon
rules: Leon has never lost a battle, only his way. Everyone strikes the Charizard pose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Still undefeated. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 4, still holding the pose. 7-19: Leon got lost on the way back. Point in a random direction and give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! His cape falls off. Give 10. · Beat 2: Charizard Gigantamaxes. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: The champion time is over. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! The champion time is over. Give 12.)

title: Geeta
rules: Geeta booked your fight in a meeting. The whole table says "per my last email." Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Mandatory overtime. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 4 and replies all. 7-19: The meeting ends early. Give 4 and leave the room for 5 seconds. 20-20: Natural 20! You take over the meeting. Give 10. · Beat 2: Glimmora Terastallizes. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: Meeting adjourned. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! Meeting adjourned. Give 12.)

title: Nemona
rules: Nemona wants to battle you again. And again. And again. The whole table fights. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One more battle! Everyone finishes their drink. 2-6: Rematch! Everyone drinks 3 and says "one more!" 7-19: She loves it. Give 4, and hug your left neighbor for her. 20-20: Natural 20! She needs a water break. Give 10. · Beat 2: Pawmot, and she's never been happier. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Again! Everyone drinks 8. 2-6: Again! Everyone drinks 4. 7-19: She finally loses. She loves it. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! She finally loses. She loves it. Give 12.)

title: Pidgey
rules: Wild Pidgey throws Sand Attack. Eyes shut: drink 2 without looking.

title: Rattata
rules: Wild Rattata chews on everyone's shoelaces. The worst shoes at the table drink 2.

title: Zigzagoon
rules: Wild Zigzagoon is zigzagging toward you. Zigzag your head with it and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You zag straight into a wall. Drink 6 and sit on the floor. 2-3: Dizzy. Drink {total}. 4-19: Pickup! Steal a sip from any drink at the table. 20-20: Natural 20! Pickup! Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

title: Bidoof
rules: Wild Bidoof appeared, with the dead eyes of a man on his fourth divorce. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-4: It stares into your soul. Drink 2 without blinking. 5-12: Bidoof wanders off to find wife five. Give 2.

title: Wooloo
rules: Wild Wooloo rolls at you like a drunk sheep. You hop it like a hurdle. Give 2.

title: Lechonk
rules: Wild Lechonk snorts through your snacks. Everyone oinks; the quietest oinker drinks 2.

title: Youngster Joey
rules: Joey says his Rattata is in the top percentage of Rattata. Prove him wrong. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It was. Drink 6 and apologize to Joey. 2-3: It was. Drink 3 and apologize to Joey. 4-19: His Rattata faints and Joey sobs. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! His Rattata faints and Joey sobs. Give 4.

title: Bug Catcher
rules: A kid with a bug net bets you can't name five bug Pokémon in 10 seconds. Lose: drink 2.

title: One-Way Ledge
rules: You hop the ledge and can never go back up. Your ankle has opinions. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rolled it. Drink 4 standing on your good foot. 2-6: Rolled it. Drink 2 standing on your good foot. 7-19: Stuck the landing. Give 1 and take a bow. 20-20: Natural 20! Stuck the landing. Give 2 and take a bow.

title: Mystery Egg
rules: A stranger in a trench coat hands you an egg. It's warm. Too warm. Crack it?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 6. 2-8: It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 3. 9-19: It hatches! Name the baby, do its cry, and give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! It hatches! Name the baby, do its cry, and give 4.

title: Oddish
rules: Wild Oddish, a radish with legs, circles you and Absorbs your drink. Drink 2.

title: Diglett
rules: A Diglett pops up between your feet and you stomp the wrong hole. Drink 2.

title: Pichu
rules: Wild Pichu sparks and shocks itself harder than you. It faints. Give 2.

title: Ace Trainer Kenny
rules: Kenny has trained since he was four, and his Rattata is in its prime. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: He explains EV training at length. Drink 3. 2-2: Rattata crits. Drink 3 and say "good game, Kenny." 3-3: Kenny cries. Everyone says "aww"; the last to say it drinks 3. 4-4: Kenny calls his mom. The player on your right plays her and scolds him, or drinks 3. 5-5: Kenny quits forever. Give 4. 6-6: Kenny gives you his hat. Give 4.

title: Lass Tiffany
rules: Lass Tiffany says you looked at her. Battle to prove you didn't. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You did. Drink 6, and look only at the floor until your next turn. 2-6: You did. Drink 3, and look only at the floor until your next turn. 7-19: She backs off out of respect. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! She backs off out of respect. Give 6.

title: Spearow
rules: Wild Spearow is angrier than any bird has a right to be. Roll d6 for its move.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Fury Attack: four pecks. Drink 4. 2-2: Peck. Rude. Give 1. 3-3: Leer. You leer back harder. Give 2. 4-4: Growl. Everyone growls at it; the quietest drinks 2. 5-5: It flies off to bother Ash. Give 2. 6-6: Drill Peck misses and hits your right neighbor. They drink 3.

title: Ekans
rules: Wild Ekans wraps your leg and hisses something filthy. Hiss back and drink 2.

title: Wurmple
rules: Wild Wurmple appeared! Nobody knows what it becomes. Not even Wurmple. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-4: Existential dread. Drink 2 and name your biggest regret. 5-12: It wanders off to evolve. Everyone says what they'd evolve into; the dullest answer drinks 2.

title: Starly
rules: A flock of Starly descends. Everyone flaps their arms; the slowest flapper drinks 2.

title: Lillipup
rules: Wild Lillipup wants belly rubs. Rub your own belly, good boy, and give 2.

title: Yungoos
rules: Wild Yungoos is a sausage with teeth and a bad attitude. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites your sausage. Drink 6 with your legs crossed. 2-4: It bites your sausage. Drink 3 with your legs crossed. 5-19: Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 4.

title: Hiker Dave
rules: Hiker Dave hasn't showered since Mt. Moon, but he shares his trail mix. Drink 2.

title: Picnicker Gina
rules: Picnicker Gina dares you to eat something off the floor. Do it or drink 3.

title: Zubat Cave
rules: Mt. Moon. No Repel. Zubat every step. Roll d6 for how many.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Six Zubat. Drink 3 and bite a neck. 2-2: Five Zubat. Drink 2, flapping. 3-3: Two Zubat. Give 1. 4-4: One Zubat. Give 1. 5-5: A Clefairy instead. Give 2. 6-6: No Zubat at all. A miracle. Give 3.

title: Old Rod
rules: Roll d20. Each bite wins a prize: reel in to keep them, or cast again and risk them all.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gyarados. Roar at the table, then drink 6. 2-7: A Magikarp slaps you and swims off. Drink 3. 8-19: A bite! Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! A Lapras surfaces and nods at you. Give 4.

title: Cuteness Contest
rules: Strike your starter's cutest pose for five seconds. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 3. Down: drink 3.

title: Seedot
rules: Wild Seedot, an acorn judging you, headbutts your shin. Drink 2.

title: Geodude
rules: The rock you sat on was a Geodude. It Defense Curls, then headbutts. Drink 2.

title: Snubbull
rules: Wild Snubbull growls through its underbite. Growl back; it wants belly rubs. Give 2.

title: Super Nerd Miguel
rules: Miguel will fight you for the Helix Fossil. He's been here for weeks. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins and explains why. Drink 6 and say "Praise Helix." 2-7: He wins and explains why. Drink 3 and say "Praise Helix." 8-19: You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 6.

title: Twins Amy & May
rules: Double battle, and both twins talk at once. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Two on two, and you lost. You and your partner drink 3. 7-12: Both twins cry in stereo. You and your partner give 2 each.

title: Coolness Contest
rules: Strike your starter's coolest pose for five seconds. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 3. Down: drink 3.

title: Psyduck
rules: Wild Psyduck clutches its head. Clutch yours too. Headache for everyone: drink 2.

title: Machop
rules: Wild Machop wants to arm-wrestle. Flex for the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 6 and say "thank you, sensei." 2-5: Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 3 and say "thank you, sensei." 6-19: You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 4.

title: Shinx
rules: Wild Shinx sparks and every hair on your body stands up. Static cling. Drink 2.

title: Roggenrola
rules: Wild Roggenrola heard what you said about it. Say something nice, then drink 2.

title: Pikipek
rules: Wild Pikipek drills a tree. Then your skull. Knock on the table, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Woodpecked. Drink 3 and rub your head. 6-12: It finds a better tree. Everyone knocks on the table; the last to stop drinks 2.

title: Nickit
rules: Wild Nickit grabs your drink and runs. Roll d20 to get it back.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You get it back, licked. Finish your drink, then a fresh one. 2-5: You get it back, licked. Finish your drink. 6-19: Recovered, with a tip. Steal a sip from any drink at the table. 20-20: Natural 20! Recovered, with a tip. Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

title: Swimmer Brad
rules: Swimmer Brad is in a Speedo on dry land and won't explain. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 6 and describe what you saw. 2-5: You looked. Drink 3 and describe what you saw. 6-19: He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 4.

title: Juggler Rico
rules: Juggler Rico juggles three Voltorb. Juggle any two things for 5 seconds or drink 3.

title: Prepare for Trouble
rules: Jessie and James net you from their balloon. Recite their motto, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Netted. Drink 3. 2-2: Meowth scratches. Drink 2. 3-3: Wobbuffet! Give 1. 4-4: They argue about the motto. Give 2. 5-5: They blast off again. Give 2. 6-6: They blast off again! Everyone points up; the last to point drinks 3. · Jinx That's Right!: The jinxed player ends every sentence with "That's right!" Slip: drink 1.

title: Voltorb
rules: A Poké Ball on the path. Pick it up? It's a Voltorb. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 6. 2-5: Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 3. 6-19: You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 2 and screams. 20-20: Natural 20! You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 4 and screams.

title: Sandshrew
rules: Wild Sandshrew curls up and rolls at your drink. Splash. Drink 2.

title: Bellsprout
rules: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six. Sway with it, then wobble. Drink 2.

title: The Recruiter
rules: Nugget Bridge's last man hands you a nugget and a Team Rocket pitch. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You signed something. Drink 8 and do the Rocket pose. 2-8: You signed something. Drink 4 and do the Rocket pose. 9-19: You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 6.

title: Cooltrainer Ava
rules: Cooltrainer Ava has six fully evolved Pokémon on Route 3. Rude. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Her Gyarados sweeps. Drink 4. 2-2: Her Alakazam reads your mind. Drink 3 and read your last text aloud. 3-3: You sweep her back. Everyone sweeps an arm; the slowest drinks 3. 4-4: She rage-quits. Give 3. 5-5: She asks for your number. Give 4. 6-6: She retires on the spot. Give 4.

title: Good Rod
rules: Roll d20. Each bite wins a prize: reel in to keep them, or cast again and risk them all.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gyarados. Roar at the table, then drink 6. 2-9: A Tentacool stings you on the way up. Drink 3. 10-19: A bite! Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! A Lapras surfaces and lets you ride it. Give 4.

title: Ponyta
rules: Wild Ponyta, a horse on fire, gallops past. Gallop around your chair, singed. Drink 2.

title: Sableye
rules: Wild Sableye eyes your teeth like gems. Grin wide as it licks its lips. Drink 2.

title: Croagunk
rules: Wild Croagunk pokes your kidney and laughs. Poke your right neighbor, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Poison Jab. Drink 3 and say "ow" like a toad. 6-12: You poke back harder. Your right neighbor drinks 3 and groans.

title: Sandile
rules: Wild Sandile wears sunglasses and doesn't care about you. Awkward. Drink 2 to break the silence.

title: Hawlucha
rules: Wild Hawlucha leaps off a tree and elbow-drops the table. Slam it, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Flying Press. Drink 4. 2-2: Body Slam. Drink 2 while your left neighbor counts to three. 3-3: You kick out at two. Give 2. 4-4: You pin it for the three count. Give 3. 5-5: Tag team: pick a partner; you both give 2. 6-6: Off the top rope! Stand on your chair and give 4.

title: Mudbray
rules: Wild Mudbray, a donkey caked in mud, wants to share. It shares. Drink 2.

title: Biker Gang
rules: The Biker Gang revs at you on Cycling Road. Make the engine noise, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The whole gang runs you over. Make the engine noise, then finish your drink. 2-6: Run over. Drink {total}. 7-19: They wipe out. Give 3 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle. 20-20: Natural 20! They wipe out. Give 6 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.

title: Psychic Tyron
rules: Think of a number from 1 to 5. Your left neighbor guesses it. Right: drink 3.

title: Snorlax Blocks the Way
rules: A Snorlax is asleep across the road. Play the Poké Flute (hum loudly) and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It rolls onto you. Drink 3. 2-2: It rolls onto you and your left neighbor. You both drink 2. 3-3: It snores and doesn't move. Drink 2 and hum louder. 4-4: It wakes up and wanders off. Give 2. 5-5: It wakes up hungry. Whoever has the most food nearby drinks 2. 6-6: It wakes up and rolls away. Give 3.

title: Slot Machine
rules: One more pull. You can feel it. Pull or walk?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The house wins. Drink 8. 2-10: The house wins. Drink 4. 11-19: Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 8.

title: Wingull
rules: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand. Rude. Drink 2.

title: Ralts
rules: Wild Ralts senses your feelings and looks worried. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It cries with you. Drink 6 for your feelings. 2-6: It cries with you. Drink 3 for your feelings. 7-19: It cheers up. Compliment the player on your left, then give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! It cheers up. Compliment the player on your left, then give 6.

title: Phanpy
rules: Wild Phanpy sprays you with its trunk. Trumpet back, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Rollout, right into your chair. Drink 3 and scoot back. 6-12: You out-trumpet it. Everyone trumpets; the weakest trumpet drinks 3.

title: Safari Toss
rules: Flick a coaster into an empty cup across the table, one try. In: give 3. Miss: drink 2.

title: Poké Flute
rules: The drawer hums a lullaby. The first player to yawn or sigh drinks 2.

title: Rival's Rant
rules: Insult the player on your left in your best rival voice. If the table finds it weak, drink 2.

title: Rocket Executive
rules: Behind the poster: a Rocket executive with a Raticate the size of a dog. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 8 and hop. 2-9: Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 4 and hop. 10-19: He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 4 and confess a guilty pleasure. 20-20: Natural 20! He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 8 and confess a guilty pleasure.

title: Gambler Lou
rules: Gambler Lou bets his whole stack. Push your drink to the middle, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He takes the pot. Drink 8. 2-9: He takes the pot. Drink 4. 10-19: You clean him out. Pick a player to pay your winnings: they drink 4 and call you boss. 20-20: Natural 20! He hands over his lucky coin too. Give 8.

title: Beauty Contest
rules: Give your best runway walk to the door and back. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 3. Down: drink 3.

title: Haunter
rules: Wild Haunter licks you, cold and lingering. Lick your lips and shiver. Drink 2.

title: Scyther
rules: Wild Scyther, knives for arms, sizes you up. Hold very still and drink 2 slowly.

title: Tauros
rules: A herd of Tauros. Everyone at the table stomps. The drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stampeded. Drink 8; the loudest stomper drinks with you. 2-6: Stampeded. Drink 4; the loudest stomper drinks with you. 7-19: You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 6.

title: Bronzor
rules: Wild Bronzor is a frying pan that floats. It hums. Hum back, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: It hums louder. Drink 3 and hum along. 6-12: You use it as a frying pan. Everyone names a breakfast food; the first to stall drinks 3.

title: Mimikyu
rules: Wild Mimikyu wears a Pikachu costume and won't let you look under it. You look away. Drink 2.

title: Toxtricity
rules: Wild Toxtricity air-guitars at you. Air-guitar back for 5 seconds, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Booed off stage. Drink 6 and play one more riff. 2-6: Booed off stage. Drink 3 and play one more riff. 7-19: Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for 5 seconds or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for 5 seconds or drink 6.

title: Beauty Cassandra
rules: Beauty Cassandra says you're not her type. Fight her about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're not. Drink 6 and compliment your left neighbor. 2-6: You're not. Drink 3 and compliment your left neighbor. 7-19: She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 6.

title: Black Belt Kenji
rules: Black Belt Kenji wants 20 push-ups. Everyone counts. Fall short: drink 3.

title: Safari Zone
rules: Thirty Safari Balls and a rock. Toss a napkin at your left neighbor, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Everything runs. Drink 3. 2-2: You hit a Tauros with the rock. Drink 3. 3-3: Out of balls. Drink 2. 4-4: Something stays. Give 2. 5-5: A Kangaskhan, with baby. You and your left neighbor give 2 each. 6-6: A Dratini! Give 4.

title: Pokémon Tower
rules: The sixth floor is haunted by a ghost Marowak. Climb or leave?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Get out... get out... Drink 8. 2-11: Get out... get out... Drink 4. 12-19: You put it to rest. Everyone whispers "rest"; the loudest drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You put it to rest. Everyone whispers "rest"; the loudest drinks 8.

title: Tangela
rules: Wild Tangela, a ball of blue spaghetti, is hungry. It tangles you up. Drink 2.

title: Engineer Bernie
rules: Engineer Bernie's Magnemite stick to your phone. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Thunder Wave. Drink 6 without moving. 2-6: Thunder Wave. Drink 3 without moving. 7-19: You stick them on the player across from you. They drink 3 and can't move until your next turn. 20-20: Natural 20! You stick them on the player across from you. They drink 6 and can't move until your next turn.

title: Spritzee
rules: Wild Spritzee smells like a department store. Sneeze. Drink 2.

title: Fan Club
rules: Praise your starter for 10 seconds. If the table gets bored, drink 2; if not, give 2.

title: Biker Boss
rules: The gang's boss has a Weezing and a prison tattoo. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Smog in the face. Drink 10; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 2. 2-9: Smog in the face. Drink 5; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 1. 10-19: He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Dragon Tamer
rules: A Dragon Tamer in a cape on a bike path. Her Dragonite is in a hurry. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Outrage. Drink 5. 2-2: Dragon Rush. Drink 4. 3-3: Thrash. Drink 3 and flail. 4-4: Tamed. Give 4. 5-5: The Dragonite gives you a lift. Give 4. 6-6: She hands you the cape. Give 5.

title: Gyarados
rules: You fished for a Magikarp and got its angry dad. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Hyper Beam. Drink 4, then recharge: say nothing until your next turn. 6-12: It wears itself out. Give 3.

title: Lucario
rules: Wild Lucario reads your aura. It knows what you did and says nothing. Drink 2.

title: Zoroark
rules: Wild Zoroark is disguised as someone here. Accuse a player, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wrong person. You and the accused drink 6. 2-6: Wrong person. You and the accused drink 3. 7-19: Found it. The accused drinks 3 and admits nothing. 20-20: Natural 20! Found it. The accused drinks 6 and admits nothing.

title: Goodra
rules: Wild Goodra, entirely slime, wants a hug. Squelch. Drink 2.

title: Tinkaton
rules: Wild Tinkaton has a hammer bigger than your car, and it wants your car. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5. 2-2: Totaled. Drink 3 and name your first car. 3-3: It hammers someone else's. Whoever drove here drinks 3. 4-4: It steals a bike instead. Give 3. 5-5: It hammers itself. Give 3. 6-6: You trade it your keys. Give 4.

title: Salandit
rules: Wild Salandit's toxic gas smells like your ex. Hold your breath. Drink 2.

title: Gentleman Alfred
rules: Gentleman Alfred challenges you to a battle with his Growlithe and his monocle. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Monocled. Drink 8 and speak posh until your next turn. 2-6: Monocled. Drink 4 and speak posh until your next turn. 7-19: He tips his hat. Give 3 in your poshest voice. 20-20: Natural 20! He tips his hat. Give 6 in your poshest voice.

title: Fisherman Ned
rules: Your left neighbor plays Fisherman Ned and tells a fish story. Top it. Ned wins the vote: drink 4.

title: Silph Co. Maze
rules: Silph Co. Eleven floors of teleport pads. Spin in your chair twice, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Lost on floor 7. Drink 3. 2-2: Teleported into a meeting. Drink 2 and say "per my last email." 3-3: Back in the lobby. Drink 2 and swap seats with someone. 4-4: Found the card key. Give 2. 5-5: Found the president. Give 3. 6-6: Found the Master Ball. Give 4.

title: Sudowoodo
rules: A tree blocks the road and won't make eye contact. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's Sudowoodo. Drink 6 and stand still like a tree. 2-6: It's Sudowoodo. Drink 3 and stand still like a tree. 7-19: You water it. It panics and runs. Everyone runs in place; the last to start drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You water it. It panics and runs. Everyone runs in place; the last to start drinks 6.

title: Rotom
rules: A Rotom got into the phone. Don't drop it. It orders pizza. Drink 2.

title: Breloom
rules: Wild Breloom throws a mushroom haymaker. Duck. It grazes you. Drink 2.

title: Campfire Legend
rules: Tell a one-sentence legend about a Legendary. The best, by vote, gives 3.

title: The Karate King
rules: The Karate King's Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan both want a piece of you. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Hitmonlee kicks. Drink 5. 2-2: Hitmonchan punches. Drink 4. 3-3: Both. Drink 3, and pick a partner who drinks 3. 4-4: You take Hitmonlee home. Give 4. 5-5: You take Hitmonchan home. Give 4. 6-6: You take both. Give 5.

title: Veteran Hugo
rules: Veteran Hugo fought in a war nobody mentions. He has a Salamence. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flamethrower. Drink 10 and tell a war story. 2-9: Flamethrower. Drink 5 and tell a war story. 10-19: Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 8.

title: Super Rod
rules: Roll d20. Each bite wins a prize: reel in to keep them, or cast again and risk them all.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gyarados, and it's angry. Drink 6, then roar. 2-11: A Feebas. Nobody wants a Feebas. Drink 3. 12-19: A bite! Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! A shiny Magikarp. Everyone else gasps and drinks 2.

title: Smartness Contest
rules: Explain how a Poké Ball works in 20 seconds. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 4. Down: drink 4.

title: Angry Snorlax
rules: A Snorlax woke up on the wrong side of the road. It yawns. Drink 3.

title: Gible's Dad
rules: You poked a Gible. Its dad, a Garchomp, appeared behind it. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Dragon Rush. Drink 4. 2-2: Earthquake. Everyone drinks 2. 3-3: You apologize to the family. Give 3. 4-4: Gible bites its dad. Give 3. 5-5: Sand Veil: it can't find you. Give 3. 6-6: It adopts you. Give 4.

title: Hydreigon
rules: Wild Hydreigon has three hungry heads. One of them bites. Drink 3.

title: Aegislash
rules: Wild Aegislash switches between sword and shield every time you swing. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: King's Shield. Drink 4 and block your face with one hand. 7-12: You sheathe it. Everyone mimes a sword fight; the worst swordsman drinks 3.

title: Dragapult
rules: Wild Dragapult fires its babies at you like missiles. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8 and duck. 2-7: Direct hit. Drink 4 and duck. 8-19: You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 3 and coo. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 6 and coo.

title: Kingambit
rules: Wild Kingambit demands you kneel. You kneel and your knees knock. Drink 3.

title: Ninja Boy
rules: A Ninja Boy jumps out of nowhere. Was he under the table? Check, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Shuriken. Drink 4. 2-2: Double Team. You and your left neighbor drink 2. 3-3: He vanishes in smoke. Give 3. 4-4: Substitute: he was a log. Give 3. 5-5: Caught him under the table. Give 4. 6-6: He was your left neighbor all along. They drink 4.

title: Sage Li
rules: Sage Li tests your balance: drink 2 on one foot with your eyes shut. Wobble: drink 4.

title: Seafoam Currents
rules: Seafoam Islands. Boulders, currents and a freezing cave. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Swept away. Drink 3. 2-2: Frozen cave. Drink 2, teeth chattering. 3-3: Boulder on your foot. Drink 2 and hop. 4-4: You Strength the boulder. Give 2. 5-5: You Surf the current. Give 3. 6-6: Articuno flies over. Everyone looks up; the last one drinks 3.

title: MissingNo.
rules: A glitch flickers on the shore. Your bag could fill up. Or your save could die.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Save corrupted. Drink 10. 2-12: Save corrupted. Drink 5. 13-19: Infinite items. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Infinite items. Give 10.

title: Ruin Maniac Liz
rules: Ruin Maniac Liz's Donphan rolls at you like a monster truck tire. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rollout. Drink 8 and roll your head in a circle. 2-7: Rollout. Drink 4 and roll your head in a circle. 8-19: You step aside and it rolls into a ruin. Pick a player to dig it out: they drink 3 and name the treasure. 20-20: Natural 20! You step aside and it rolls into a ruin. Pick a player to dig it out: they drink 6 and name the treasure.

title: Gardevoir
rules: Wild Gardevoir would give its life for its trainer. You are not its trainer. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It reads your search history aloud. Drink 8. 2-7: It reads your search history aloud. Drink 4. 8-19: It teleports away, blushing. Pick a player to blush like it: they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! It teleports away, blushing. Pick a player to blush like it: they drink 6.

title: Wailord
rules: A Wailord surfaces and blots out the sun. Everyone looks up. Splash. Everyone drinks 1.

title: Pep Talk
rules: Give the player on your right a 10-second pep talk. They're moved: give 3. They're not: drink 2.

title: Rival's Dare
rules: The player on your left names a Pokémon for you to describe in 10 seconds. Blank: drink 3.

title: Scientist Blaine Jr.
rules: Blaine's son made a Mewtwo in a jar. He wants to test it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Psystrike. Drink 10, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud. 2-10: Psystrike. Drink 5, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud. 11-19: The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 6.

title: Burglar Sid
rules: Burglar Sid is robbing the mansion and you caught him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He robs you too. Drink 10, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink. 2-10: He robs you too. Drink 5, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink. 11-19: He leaves the loot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! He leaves the loot. Give 8.

title: Toughness Contest
rules: Flex like your starter for five seconds. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 4. Down: drink 4.

title: Tyranitar
rules: Wild Tyranitar kicks up a sandstorm. Everyone covers their drink. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stone Edge. Drink 10; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 4. 2-7: Stone Edge. Drink 5; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 2. 8-19: You weather the storm. Everyone shakes sand from their hair; the last to finish drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You weather the storm. Everyone shakes sand from their hair; the last to finish drinks 8.

title: Metagross
rules: Wild Metagross is four brains in a steel X. It already knows your roll. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It knew. Drink 5 and say "I knew it" like a robot. 7-12: It miscounted. Think of a number from 1 to 10; your left neighbor guesses it, and drinks 4 if wrong.

title: Volcarona
rules: Wild Volcarona is a moth made of sun. Do a Quiver Dance. Dazzling. Drink 3.

title: Kommo-o
rules: Wild Kommo-o rattles its scales like a metal concert. Headbang, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Clangorous Soul. Drink 5. 2-2: Mosh pit. You and both neighbors drink 2. 3-3: You crowd-surf away. Give 4. 4-4: Encore. Give 4. 5-5: You steal its guitar. Give 4. 6-6: It throws you a pick. Give 5.

title: Baxcalibur
rules: Wild Baxcalibur has a sword for a spine and it is very cold. Brr. Drink 3.

title: Gengar
rules: Wild Gengar is behind you. No, the other side. Turn around and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Hypnosis. Drink 4 with your eyes shut. 2-2: Curse. You and whoever you turned toward drink 3. 3-3: It grins and fades. Give 4. 4-4: Shadow Ball misses. Give 4. 5-5: It haunts your left neighbor now. They drink 4. 6-6: It laughs so hard it vanishes. Give 5.

title: Cooltrainer Duo
rules: Two Cooltrainers, matching jackets, matching Dragonites. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Double Outrage. You and your partner drink 4. 7-12: Their jackets are ruined. You and your partner give 2 each.

title: PokéManiac Ed
rules: PokéManiac Ed dares you to name 10 Pokémon in 15 seconds. Miss: drink 4.

title: The Waterfall
rules: The only way up is Waterfall. Mime climbing one, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You fall. Drink 4. 2-2: You fall onto a Magikarp. Drink 3. 3-3: Halfway, then down. Drink 2. 4-4: Wet, but you hang on. Drink 1. 5-5: You make it up. Give 2. 6-6: You are the waterfall. Start one to your left; you may stop first.

title: The Truck
rules: There's a truck by the S.S. Anne. Everyone knows Mew is under it. Strength it?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 10. 2-13: Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 5. 14-19: Mew. Kind of. Everyone points at it; the last to point drinks 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Mew. Kind of. Everyone points at it; the last to point drinks 10.

title: Rhyperior
rules: Wild Rhyperior fires rocks out of its hands. Duck, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Rock Wrecker, square on. Drink 4 and hold a rock pose. 7-12: You catch one and keep it. Throw it back at someone: they drink 4.

title: Electivire
rules: Wild Electivire plugs its tails into the wall and the lights dim. Brownout. Drink 3.

title: Togekiss
rules: Wild Togekiss blesses the table, then wants a battle. Blessed. Everyone drinks 1.

title: Champion Rumor
rules: Make up a rumor about the Champion in one sentence. The best, by vote, gives 3.

title: Badge Check
rules: The player on your left asks you to name 3 gym leaders in 10 seconds. Miss: drink 3.

title: Ace Trainer Rex
rules: Rex says he'd be Champion if he'd tried. He has a Garchomp. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He tried. Drink 10 and say "you could be Champion, Rex." 2-10: He tried. Drink 5 and say "you could be Champion, Rex." 11-19: Rex goes home to his mom. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Rex goes home to his mom. Give 10.

title: Elite Four Reject
rules: An Elite Four member who got fired. Still bitter. Still good. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Still good. Drink 5. 8-12: Still fired. Give 5.

title: Golurk
rules: A Golurk, a robot of clay and grudges, guards Victory Road. It lets you pass. Drink 3.

title: Steelix
rules: A Steelix is the floor of the cave, and it rumbles. Drink 3.

title: Machamp
rules: Wild Machamp, four arms and no shirt, gets personal. Four high fives. Drink 3.

title: Boulder Puzzle
rules: Victory Road's boulder puzzle. You pushed one wrong and now you're stuck. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Restart the puzzle. Drink 8 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 2-12: Restart the puzzle. Drink 4 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 13-19: Solved. Give 3, smugly. 20-20: Natural 20! Solved. Give 6, smugly.

title: Veteran Ada
rules: Veteran Ada wants proof. Name the eight gym leaders you beat this run. Miss one: drink 4.

title: Ace Trainer Ilse
rules: Ace Trainer Ilse has six Pokémon and no mercy. Roll d6 for how many you beat.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: One. Drink 6. 2-2: Two. Drink 5. 3-3: Three. Drink 4. 4-4: Four. Drink 3. 5-5: Five of six. Give 4. 6-6: All six. Give 6.

title: Ace Trainer Ben
rules: Ace Trainer Ben has been on Victory Road for nine years. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Nine years of practice. Drink 10, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years. 2-12: Nine years of practice. Drink 5, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years. 13-19: Ben finally goes home. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Ben finally goes home. Give 10.

title: Blue
rules: Smell ya later! Your rival shows up again with a full team and a haircut. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He smells ya. Drink 10 and sniff your own armpit. 2-8: He smells ya. Drink 5 and sniff your own armpit. 9-19: He cries to Grandpa. Give 4 and say "smell ya later." 20-20: Natural 20! He cries to Grandpa. Give 8 and say "smell ya later." · Beat 2: His second Pokémon. Rock, paper, scissors with your left neighbor, playing Blue. Lose: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: Silver
rules: Silver stole his starter and wants to steal yours. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Stolen. Drink 5. 2-2: He steals your seat. Drink 3 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 3-3: He learns to love his Pokémon. Give 4. 4-4: He calls you a wimp, then cries. Give 4. 5-5: He hands back your starter. Give 4. 6-6: He calls his dad. It's Giovanni. Give 5. · Beat 2: He's cheating now. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: He steals your drink. Drink 4. 2-2: He steals your seat. Drink 3. 3-3: You catch him. Give 3. 4-4: You call his mom. Give 3. 5-5: He cries. Give 4. 6-6: He apologizes. Everyone else drinks 2.)

title: Wally
rules: Wally got healthy. Wally got strong. Wally has a Gallade. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wally is so strong now. Drink 10 and cheer for him. 2-8: Wally is so strong now. Drink 5 and cheer for him. 9-19: Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 4. · Beat 2: Wally needs a pep talk. Give your left neighbor one for ten seconds; they judge it. Flat: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: Barry
rules: Barry runs into you and fines you ten million. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Pay up. Drink 5. 7-12: He runs off to fine someone else. Pick who; they drink 4. · Beat 2: Pay the fine in compliments: three to your left neighbor in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: Hop
rules: Hop made curry for the road and wants it rated. Rate it out loud, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He took that personally. Drink 10 and rate it higher. 2-8: He took that personally. Drink 5 and rate it higher. 9-19: He takes notes for next time. Give 4, mate. 20-20: Natural 20! He takes notes for next time. Give 8, mate. · Beat 2: Hop wants a better curry. Name five curry ingredients in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: Nemona
rules: Nemona skipped class to fight you. She's been stretching for an hour. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She was going easy on you. Finish your drink. 2-8: She's warmed up. Drink {total} and stretch with her. 9-19: She asks to go again. Give 4, then high-five everyone. 20-20: Natural 20! She asks to go again. Give 8, then high-five everyone. · Beat 2: One more! Ten jumping jacks while the table counts. Stop: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: Rocket Grunt
rules: A Rocket Grunt guards the basement under the Game Corner. He has a Zubat. Of course. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Zubat. Of course. Drink 3. 6-12: He gives up the Lift Key. Give 3.

title: Slowpoke Tail Seller
rules: A Grunt sells twitching Slowpoke Tails. You buy one out of fear. Drink 2, slowly.

title: Spinner Tiles
rules: A Grunt laughs as you spin on the spinner tiles. Dizzy. Drink 2.

title: Giovanni
rules: Giovanni strokes his Persian and doesn't look up. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Persian's Slash. Drink 5. 2-2: Earthquake. Drink 4 and kiss his ring. 3-3: He looks up. Give 4. 4-4: He finally looks worried. Give 4. 5-5: Persian switches sides. Give 4 and meow. 6-6: He says you remind him of his son. Give 5. · Beat 2: He stands up. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing Giovanni. Blink first: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Magma Grunt
rules: A Magma Grunt in a red hood wants more land. You hold your chair. Drink 2.

title: Sweaty Grunt
rules: A Grunt in a full hoodie inside a volcano is so sweaty. He hugs you. Drink 2.

title: Tabitha
rules: Admin Tabitha laughs like a cartoon villain. Laugh back like one, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: His laugh wins. Drink 3. 6-12: Yours wins. Give 3.

title: Maxie
rules: Maxie pushes up his glasses and wakes Groudon. The room heats up. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Drought. Fan yourself, then drink 10. 2-7: Drought. Fan yourself, then drink 5. 8-19: Groudon goes back to sleep. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Groudon goes back to sleep. Give 8. · Beat 2: Groudon's awake again, and angrier. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Precipice Blades. Drink 10. 2-7: Precipice Blades. Drink 5. 8-19: Maxie's glasses crack. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Maxie's glasses crack. Give 8.)

title: Aqua Grunt
rules: An Aqua Grunt wants more sea and splashes you with it. Soggy. Drink 2.

title: Submarine Thief
rules: A Grunt is stealing a submarine and asks you to look away. You look away. Drink 2.

title: Shelly
rules: Admin Shelly yawns at you, big. Everyone else: don't yawn back. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Asleep. Drink 6 with your eyes shut. 2-6: Asleep. Drink 3 with your eyes shut. 7-19: Awake. Anyone who yawned drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Awake. Anyone who yawned drinks 4.

title: Archie
rules: Archie rips his shirt open and wakes Kyogre. It starts raining indoors. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Drenched. Drink 10 and wring out your shirt. 2-7: Drenched. Drink 5 and wring out your shirt. 8-19: Kyogre goes back to sleep and Archie buttons his shirt. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Kyogre goes back to sleep and Archie buttons his shirt. Give 8. · Beat 2: Rain Dance: dance for ten seconds, shirt half open. The table votes. Weak: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Galactic Grunt
rules: A Galactic Grunt's bowl cut is also a uniform. You can't stop staring. Drink 2.

title: Mars
rules: Commander Mars wants your Pokémon for science. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! For science. Drink 6. 2-6: For science. Drink 3. 7-19: Science denied. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Science denied. Give 6. · Jinx Lab Rat: Everyone calls the jinxed player Subject 7. Slip: drink 1.

title: Charon
rules: Charon the scientist cackles and points a ray gun at you. Zap. Drink 2.

title: Cyrus
rules: Cyrus wants to erase all emotion. Everyone hold a straight face while the drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Feelings erased. Drink 10 without any expression. 2-7: Feelings erased. Drink 5 without any expression. 8-19: Cyrus flinches. The first player who smiled drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Cyrus flinches. The first player who smiled drinks 6. · Beat 2: No emotions: the table has ten seconds to make you smile. Smile: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Plasma Grunt
rules: A Plasma Grunt dressed as a knight tells you to free your Pokémon. You nod politely. Drink 2.

title: Sage
rules: One of the Seven Sages lectures you about Pokémon liberation. You sit through it. Drink 2.

title: N
rules: N rambles about truth and ideals. Your left neighbor does N for 5 seconds; you roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: You can't keep up. Drink 3. 6-12: N spins away on a Ferris wheel. Give 3.

title: Ghetsis
rules: Ghetsis, in a cape with eyes on it, calls you worthless trash. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Worthless. Drink 10 and call yourself trash. 2-7: Worthless. Drink 5 and call yourself trash. 8-19: His cape rips. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! His cape rips. Give 8. · Beat 2: Prove you're not trash: name three things you're good at in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Flare Grunt
rules: A Flare Grunt in a red suit says your outfit is ugly. You pout. Drink 2.

title: Flare Scientist
rules: A Flare scientist in orange goggles shows you a doomsday weapon. It's a hair dryer. Drink 2.

title: Flare Admin
rules: A Flare admin charges five million to join. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You paid. Drink 6 and compliment everyone's outfit. 2-6: You paid. Drink 3 and compliment everyone's outfit. 7-19: You talk her down. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You talk her down. Give 6.

title: Lysandre
rules: Lysandre's hair is on fire, figuratively. He wants a beautiful world. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Beautiful. Drink 5. 7-12: The ultimate weapon misfires. Give 4. · Beat 2: Describe your beautiful world in one sentence. The table votes. Ugly: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Skull Grunt
rules: A Skull Grunt strikes the Skull pose and says YO. Everyone poses; the worst pose drinks 2.

title: Rapping Grunt
rules: A Skull Grunt raps at you badly. Rap back four lines. A draw. Drink 2.

title: Plumeria
rules: Big sis Plumeria wants to know why you hurt her boys. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: She hurts you. Drink 3. 2-2: She calls your mom. Drink 3 and apologize. 3-3: She respects you. Give 3. 4-4: She lets her boys go home. Give 3. 5-5: She buys you a drink. Give 4. 6-6: She joins your side. Give 4.

title: Guzma
rules: Guzma is the hated boss who beats you down. He says so himself. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Beaten down. Drink 10, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 2-7: Beaten down. Drink 5, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 8-19: Guzma, what is you doing? Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Guzma, what is you doing? Give 8. · Beat 2: Arm wrestle your left neighbor, playing Guzma. Lose: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Oleana
rules: Oleana, Chairman Rose's secretary, has a meeting with you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The meeting ran long. Drink 6 and summarize it for the table. 2-6: The meeting ran long. Drink 3 and summarize it for the table. 7-19: Meeting cancelled. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Meeting cancelled. Give 6.

title: Macro Intern
rules: An intern asks for a feedback survey before battling. Five stars. Drink 2.

title: Tower Security
rules: Tower Security wants your ID badge. You show your phone. Drink 2.

title: Chairman Rose
rules: Chairman Rose woke Eternatus to fix the energy crisis a thousand years early. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Darkest Day. Drink 5 with your eyes shut. 7-12: The lights stay on. Give 4. · Beat 2: Eternatus drains the power grid. Roll 2d6 to keep the lights on. (2d6 — 2-6: Blackout. Drink 5. 7-12: The lights stay on. Give 4.)

title: Star Grunt
rules: A Team Star grunt does the Star Shuffle. Do it with her. Good shuffle. Drink 2.

title: Starmobile
rules: A boss revs a Starmobile made of Revavroom. Rev with your mouth, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Run over. Drink 3. 6-12: It stalls. Give 3.

title: Star Squad
rules: Thirty grunts, thirty seconds, everyone points at you. You hold your ground. Drink 2.

title: Cassiopeia
rules: Cassiopeia was the Champion's classmate all along. Plot twist. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Twist. Drink 5. 2-2: Double twist: she's also your left neighbor. You both drink 3. 3-3: Her Sylveon flinches. Give 4. 4-4: Her Umbreon trips. Give 4. 5-5: Her headset glitches. Give 4. 6-6: She cries. Give 5. · Beat 2: Plot twist: tell the table one thing about you nobody here knows. Refuse: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Pineco
rules: Pineco used Protect! Drink 2. Until your next turn, ignore every drink given to you.

title: Raticate
rules: Raticate used Pursuit! For the rest of the game, drink 1 whenever you leave the table.

title: Mankey
rules: Mankey used Swagger! Teach the table a secret handshake. Until your next turn, fumble it: drink 1.

title: Aipom
rules: Aipom used Baton Pass! Until your next turn, pass every drink you're given to another player.

title: Skarmory
rules: Steel Wing! Drink 3. Until your next turn, drinks given to you bounce to your right neighbor.

title: Tropius
rules: Tropius used Sweet Scent! Until your next turn, every drink given out comes to you instead.

title: Sandshrew
rules: Sandshrew used Sand Attack! Drink with your non-dominant hand for the rest of the game.

title: Shuppet
rules: Shuppet used Curse! For the rest of the game, drink 1 every time you curse.

title: Lapras
rules: Lapras used Confuse Ray! Pick a player: questions only until your next turn. Slip: drink 1.

title: Togepi
rules: Togepi hatched! Make a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Eevee
rules: Eeveelution time! Choose a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Trick House
rules: The Trick House! Make a tricky new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Pokémon Tower
rules: Out of respect for the dead: no talking until your next turn. Slip and drink 1.

title: Barboach
rules: Barboach's Mud-Slap! Pick a player. Rest of the game: they can finish a full drink to slap you once.

title: Bulbasaur
rules: Bulbasaur chose you. Everyone sniff the bulb. Max HP 14. Every heal heals 2 more.

title: Charmander
rules: Charmander chose you. Keep its tail lit. +2 to route battle d20s.

title: Squirtle
rules: Squirtle chose you, in sunglasses. The bag holds 2. Starts with a Protect.

title: Pikachu
rules: Pikachu won't evolve. Ever. Max HP 17. +1 to every battle d20. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

title: Eevee

dice: Secret: BACHELORETTE. Banned: bride, party, wedding, sash, Nashville. · Clock 60 s: Time. Guessed clean? Give 3. Banned word or no guess? Drink 3.

rules: Read alone. Start the clock; get the table to guess the word without a banned word.
dice: Secret: TATTOO. Banned: ink, needle, skin, arm, artist. · Clock 60 s: Time. Guessed clean? Give 3. Banned word or no guess? Drink 3.

dice: Secret: Building IKEA furniture drunk. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed? You both give 2. Nobody did? You drink 3.

title: Staring Contest
rules: Start the clock and stare down your left neighbor. First to look away or laugh drinks 3.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Nobody broke? You both drink 2.

title: Straight Face
rules: Start the clock. Everyone tries to make you laugh; keep a straight face the whole time.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Cracked? Drink 3. Held it? Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Plank It
rules: Start the clock and hold a plank until time's up. Drop early and you drink 4.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Still up? Give 4.

title: Backwards
rules: Start the clock and say the alphabet backwards, Z to A, before time runs out.
dice: Clock 20 s: Time. Made it to A? Give 3. Didn't? Drink 3.

title: Wall Sit
rules: Start the clock and wall sit until time's up. Stand early and you drink 4.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Still sitting? Give 4.

title: No Blinking
rules: Start the clock and don't blink until time's up. Your left neighbor watches.
dice: Clock 15 s: Time. Blinked? Drink 3. Didn't? Give 3.

title: Tongue Twister
rules: Start the clock and say "red lorry, yellow lorry" five times before time runs out.
dice: Clock 10 s: Time. Tripped up or ran out? Drink 3. Nailed it? Give 3.

title: Secret Rule
rules: Read alone. It holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may say the word "drink."

title: Secret Rule
rules: Read alone. It holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may point with a finger.

title: Secret Rule
rules: Read alone. It holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may say anyone's name.

title: Lost and Found
rules: Everything anyone lost down here, plus a coaster that looks bulletproof. Drink 1.

title: The Tip Jar
rules: A tip jar lost under the shelves since 2011. A loaded die rattles in the coins. Drink 1.

title: Rat Fence
rules: A rat in a tiny vest is selling whatever fell behind the bar. He takes drinks, or blood.

title: The Old Regular
rules: He's been down here since the cellar was a bar. He'll trade a story for a story.

title: Cellar Master's Coat
rules: A coat on a hook with full pockets: a corkscrew and a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

title: The Magnum
rules: A magnum of something nice behind the racks. Drink 1, and cork the rest for later.

title: The Cellar Cat
rules: A cat in a sommelier's chain trades mouse-bitten goods. It takes drinks, or blood.

title: The Vintner
rules: A tiny man in a huge hat sells you a vintage. He insists you taste first.

title: The Bone Pile
rules: Under the bones: a smoke bomb and a stranger's fake ID. Keep both. Drink 1.

title: The Offering Bowl
rules: A bowl of coins left for the dead, and a draught nobody touched. Take it. Drink 1.

title: The Grave Robber
rules: A grave robber with a cart of stolen goods and no questions asked. Prices are firm.

title: The Undertaker
rules: He measures you for a coffin while he sells you things. He's very thorough.

title: Flushed Purse
rules: A purse dropped down a toilet, somehow dry: lipstick, a lighter, an open bar tab. Drink 1.

title: Maintenance Locker
rules: A hard hat on a hook, and a thermos of something brown. Drink 1 from the thermos.

title: The Mole Man
rules: A man who lives down here sells whatever washes past. He takes drinks, or blood.

title: The Rat Pharmacist
rules: A rat in a white coat with a briefcase of pills, potions and one very old book.

title: Message in a Bottle
rules: It says drink me. Of course it does. Drink 1, and keep the bottle.

title: The Lifebuoy
rules: A lifebuoy off the wall, still inflated. Wear it with pride. Drink 1.

title: The Pearl Diver
rules: A diver in a rusted helmet trades whatever he finds at the bottom of the bar.

title: The Ferryman
rules: A hooded figure in a pedal boat takes you across, for a price, and sells extras.

title: Staff Meal
rules: Fries, pickles, and a shot the cooks hid for you. Drink 1, and pocket a smoke bomb.

title: Knife Roll
rules: A chef's knife roll left on the pass, something heavy in the end pocket. Drink 1.

title: The Dishwasher
rules: The dishwasher has seen everything, and he'll sell you some of it, for drinks or blood.

title: The Sous Chef
rules: The sous chef is selling the head chef's stash, quietly, out the back.

title: Bottle Cap Stash
rules: A jar of bottle caps, and a loaded die someone hid in it. Drink 1.

title: The Growler
rules: A full growler on a shelf, sealed, labeled YOURS. Drink 1, and keep it.

title: The Apprentice
rules: The brewmaster's apprentice is selling off the good stuff while the boss is out.

title: The Hop Dealer
rules: He sells hops out of a trench coat and wants you to agree his beer is best.

title: The Lost Parka
rules: A parka on a hook, a hip flask in the pocket. Drink 1, and keep the flask.

title: The Ice Tray
rules: An ice tray, every cube frozen around a coin. One of them is a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

title: The Yeti
rules: A yeti in a cardigan runs a little shop out of the ice cream aisle.

title: The Frozen Mime
rules: A mime who got stuck in here mid-act. He sells by pointing.

title: Left Behind
rules: A box behind the bar: one shoe, one earring and a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

title: The Abandoned Table
rules: A whole table left for the bathroom and never came back. Their bottle is yours. Drink 1.

title: The Rooftop Bartender
rules: A bartender in a linen shirt selling $24 cocktails, and she takes blood.

title: The Bottle Girl
rules: A sparkler bottle, a spreadsheet of tables, and a spot in the corner, for a price.

title: Wishing Drain
rules: A floor drain full of coins and one fry. Everyone makes a wish out loud and toasts it.

title: The Dead Jukebox
rules: It plays one song, badly, forever. Everyone sings the chorus, whatever they think it is.

title: Two Hatches
rules: Two hatches. One is quiet. The other is blasting Nickelback, on purpose.

title: Staff Only
rules: Two doors: STAFF ONLY and REALLY STAFF ONLY. The second one growls.

title: Roll Call
rules: Everyone says the dumbest thing they've done in a cellar. The table picks the worst; they drink 2.

title: Mystery Bottle
rules: A dusty bottle, no label. Everyone guesses what's in it; the drawer's favorite guess gives 2.

title: Spider Check
rules: Everyone checks their hair for spiders, loudly. The last to finish drinks 1.

title: Dry Storage
rules: You find a crate of crackers. Everyone eats one or drinks 1.

title: The Last Clean Glass
rules: Bid sips for the last clean glass, clockwise, until everyone passes. Top bid drinks it and toasts.

title: The Tasting Room
rules: Cheese, crackers, and one clean glass. Everyone toasts the cheese.

title: The Candle Nook
rules: A nook with a hundred melted candles. Everyone makes a wish and blows out a pretend one.

title: Red or White
rules: Two aisles. White is quiet. Red is where the screaming is coming from.

title: The Bung Hole
rules: A barrel big enough to crawl through, or the stairs. Something inside is giggling.

title: The Pairing
rules: Everyone names the food their drink pairs with. The table boos the worst; they drink 2.

title: Swirl and Sniff
rules: Everyone swirls and sniffs their drink like a snob, and holds eye contact. First to laugh drinks 2.

title: Your Vintage
rules: Everyone says the year they'd be if they were a wine. The oldest answer drinks 2.

title: Proper Cheers
rules: Everyone clinks with everyone, eyes locked, or it's bad luck. Anyone who skips someone drinks 1.

title: Vintage
rules: Everyone names their best year, fast, around the table. Repeat a year or stall: drink 2.

title: Candlelit Alcove
rules: Someone left candles and a case of water down here. Everyone drinks water. Yes, really.

title: The Ossuary Bar
rules: A bar made of bones, closed for centuries, with one last round. Everyone toasts the dead.

title: The Split
rules: The tunnel splits. Left: silence. Right: drums, chanting, maybe a conga line.

title: Two Crypts
rules: Two crypt doors. One says REST. The other says PARTY, in fresh blood.

title: Your Epitaph
rules: Everyone says what their tombstone will say. The table picks the best; they give 3.

title: Skull Face
rules: Everyone pulls their best skull face at once. The table picks the scariest; they give 2.

title: Bone Count
rules: Count off around the table, skipping every multiple of three. Whoever messes up drinks 2.

title: Candlelight
rules: Phone lights up for a moment of silence for the fallen. Anyone who talks drinks 1.

title: Epitaphs
rules: Everyone says their own epitaph in five words. The table picks a favorite; they give 3.

title: Storm Drain Skylight
rules: A grate overhead and real moonlight. Everyone looks up and makes a wish.

title: The Dry Ledge
rules: A dry ledge, a cooler and two lawn chairs. Everyone sits back and takes one slow sip.

title: Two Pipes
rules: Two pipes. One drips. The other gurgles, and it sounds like laughing.

title: The Overflow
rules: A dry service tunnel, or the overflow pipe, where something big just splashed.

title: Worst Smell
rules: Everyone describes the worst thing they've ever smelled. The table gags at the winner, who gives 3.

title: Rubber Duck
rules: A rubber duck floats by. Everyone quacks; the worst quack drinks 2.

title: Gator Chomp
rules: On three, everyone does the gator chomp with both arms. The last one drinks 2.

title: Clean Water
rules: A clean pipe. Everyone takes a sip of water and says something nice about the person to their right.

title: Down the Drain
rules: Everyone says the worst thing they ever lost down a drain. The table picks the worst; they drink 2.

title: The Air Pocket
rules: A pocket of air and a jukebox that still works. Everyone sings a chorus, any chorus.

title: The Last Dry Booth
rules: One booth the water never reached. Sit. Breathe. Everyone toasts dry socks.

title: Two Taps
rules: Two taps. One pours water. The other pours something that screams.

title: The Trapdoor
rules: The cellar stairs, or a trapdoor behind the bar with bubbles coming up through it.

title: The Shanty
rules: The drawer starts a sea shanty; everyone joins on the second line. Anyone silent drinks 2.

title: Message in a Bottle
rules: Everyone says what they'd write in a message in a bottle. The saddest one drinks 2.

title: Man Overboard
rules: The drawer shouts 'man overboard'; everyone grabs their drink. The last to grab it drinks 2.

title: Dry Land
rules: You find a dry booth. Everyone sits up straight and takes a breath.

title: Shanty Round
rules: Everyone adds a line to a sea shanty, clockwise. First to stall drinks 2.

title: The Break Room
rules: A couch, a microwave, and twelve minutes of peace. Everyone sits down and sips.

title: Family Meal
rules: The cooks sit down to eat, and they set a place for you. Everyone toasts the cooks.

title: The Pass
rules: Two ways out: the quiet back door, or straight through the line in the dinner rush.

title: The Dumbwaiter
rules: The fire stairs, or the dumbwaiter, which is shaking and going down on its own.

title: Yes, Chef
rules: The drawer is chef until their next turn. Anyone who doesn't answer them with 'Yes, chef' drinks 1.

title: Last Meal
rules: Everyone names their last meal on earth. The table picks the weirdest; they drink 2.

title: Order Up
rules: The drawer shouts an order; everyone repeats it back. Anyone who gets it wrong drinks 2.

title: Staff Meal
rules: Everyone takes a bite of something, or a sip, and thanks the kitchen.

title: Drunk Food
rules: Everyone names their go-to drunk food at once. Anyone who matches someone drinks 2.

title: The Beer Garden
rules: A courtyard, fairy lights and long tables. Everyone toasts their left neighbor.

title: Brewer's Break
rules: Pretzels, mustard and one working chair. Everyone eats a pretend pretzel and sips.

title: Two Vats
rules: Two vats to climb through. One is empty. The other bubbles and hums.

title: The Conveyor Belt
rules: Duck under the bottling line, or ride the belt into the noisy room.

title: Tasting Flight
rules: Pass your drink left; everyone takes one sip of their neighbor's and rates it out of ten.

title: Beer Names
rules: Go around inventing a craft beer name for the player on your left. The worst one drinks 2.

title: Foam Mustache
rules: Everyone gives themself a drink mustache. The table picks the best; they give 2.

title: Quality Control
rules: The drawer inspects everyone's drink and approves it. Rejected drinks get a sip taken out.

title: Name a Beer
rules: Category: beer brands, clockwise, no repeats. First to stall or repeat drinks 2.

title: The Compressor
rules: Warm air blowing out of a vent. Everyone huddles in and sips.

title: Hot Chocolate
rules: A thermos of hot chocolate, still warm, with a note: FOR WHOEVER'S NEXT. Everyone sips, slowly.

title: Two Shelves
rules: Behind the frozen peas, or through the ice cream aisle, where something licks.

title: The Meat Hooks
rules: Duck under the empty hooks, or push through the full ones, swinging on their own.

title: Penguin Walk
rules: The drawer waddles like a penguin to the nearest wall and back. Refuse: drink 3.

title: Cold Take
rules: Everyone shares their coldest take. The table picks the coldest; they give 3.

title: Huddle Up
rules: Everyone huddles in for warmth. Anyone who won't drinks 2.

title: Hot Cocoa
rules: Everyone warms their hands on their drink and takes a slow, cozy sip.

title: Cold Takes
rules: Everyone shares a cold take. The table boos the coldest one; its owner drinks 2.

title: The View
rules: The whole city, lit up below. Everyone stops, looks, and drinks to it.

title: The Fire Pit
rules: A fire pit and a ring of chairs. Everyone sits closer than they need to and sips.

title: Two Terraces
rules: The quiet terrace with fairy lights, or the loud one with the private party.

title: The Open Window
rules: Take the stairs across, or climb through the open window, where someone is shouting.

title: Skyline Toast
rules: Everyone toasts something they can see from here. Repeat a toast: drink 2.

title: Shooting Star
rules: The drawer makes a wish out loud. If the table thinks it's lame, the drawer drinks 2.

title: The Pigeon
rules: A pigeon lands on the table. Everyone coos; the worst coo drinks 2.

title: Fresh Air
rules: Everyone takes a deep breath of fresh air. Then a sip.

title: First to Post
rules: On three, everyone points at who will post this roof first. Most fingers: give 3.

title: The Stairwell
rules: A cold stairwell and one flickering bulb. Everyone stretches. Level up, or sit down.

title: The Smoking Area
rules: Fresh air, a dead heater, somebody's vape. Everyone names their best moment so far.

title: The Coat Check
rules: An empty coat check. Everyone names the coat they'd steal. Level up, or nap on the pile.

title: The Bathroom Line
rules: Twelve deep, and everyone's best friends now. Everyone hypes their left neighbor.

title: The Loading Dock
rules: Pallets, a puddle, one working vending machine. Everyone names the snack they'd get.

title: The Phone Booth
rules: An old phone booth, and the phone works. Everyone says who they'd call right now.

title: The Mop Closet
rules: Mops, buckets, one comfy bucket. Everyone gives their left neighbor a wrestling name.

title: The Photo Booth
rules: A broken photo booth that still flashes. Everyone pulls their best face on three.

title: The Boiler Room
rules: Warm pipes and somebody's cot. Everyone warms their hands. Level up, or lie down.

title: A Campfire
rules: Someone lit a fire in a keg. Everyone tells the scariest thing that's happened tonight.

title: The Staff Room
rules: A kettle and a sign: WASH YOUR OWN MUG. Everyone mimes washing one.

title: The Fire Escape
rules: Stars, a city, and the street far below. Everyone toasts how far you've come.

title: The Service Stairs
rules: Halfway down, a step wide enough to sit on. Everyone says what they'd order right now.

title: The Bunker
rules: An old bomb shelter with canned beans. Everyone names who they'd want down here.

title: The Laundry Room
rules: Warm dryers humming. Everyone confesses their worst laundry crime.

title: The Stuck Elevator
rules: An elevator stuck between floors, the music still playing. Everyone hums along on three.

title: Gelatinous Shot
rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots, a tooth floating in it. Hands behind your back. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You find the tooth. It's yours now. Drink 6, no hands. 2-6: It engulfs you. Drink 3, no hands. 7-19: You eat your way out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the whole thing, tooth and all. Give 6.

title: Rats in a Coat
rules: Nine rats in a coat get carded. Left neighbor bounces: talk your way in, 10 seconds. Out: drink 3.

title: Mold Elemental
rules: The thing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Hold your breath and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 6 and cough on both neighbors. 2-6: You breathe it in. Drink 3 and cough on your left neighbor. 7-19: Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! It thanks you for the bleach. Everyone else holds their breath; first to gasp drinks 6.

title: Drunk Goblin
rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Arms out, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He hugs you and won't let go. Drink 6 with an arm around your right neighbor. 2-6: He wins both. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor. 7-19: He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He passes out, and his pockets are deep. Give 4, and everyone toasts the goblin.

title: Skeleton Barback
rules: On three, everyone points at who looks like they work here since 1974. Most fingers: drink 2.

title: Possessed Mop
rules: A possessed mop sweeps under the table. Last to lift both feet off the floor drinks 2.

title: Keg Spider
rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Wiggle eight fingers at it, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lays eggs in your drink. Drink 6, then spider-walk to the fridge and back. 2-6: Bitten. Drink 3, and do a spider walk to the fridge and back. 7-19: Squished. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 6.

title: Tab Goblin
rules: The Tab Goblin wants paying. Your right neighbor plays him: thumb war, best of three. Lose: drink 4.

title: Goblin Shaman
rules: A goblin in a bucket hat waves a burnt sage stick at you and chants. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The chant works. Drink 6. 2-6: The chant works. Drink 3. 7-19: You blow out the sage. Give 3 to whoever smells most like it. 20-20: Natural 20! You blow out the sage. Give 6 to whoever smells most like it. · Jinx Goblin Tongue: The jinxed player speaks of themself in the third person. Slip: drink 1.

title: Cask Bat
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a beer as you pass. The bat hits whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The bat swoops. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Clipboard Troll
rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

title: The Riddling Tap
rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

title: The Stuck Door
rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

title: Keg Stand-Off
rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor. You blink or laugh first: drink 3.

title: Sticky Floor
rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4, and stay one shoe down until your next turn. 2-8: You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2, and stay one shoe down until your next turn. 9-19: You peel free. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You peel free and moonwalk. Everyone copies it; the worst moonwalk drinks 4.

title: Tripwire
rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4. 2-8: You eat the stairs. Drink 2. 9-19: You hop it. Give 2 to the clumsiest player here. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4 to the clumsiest player here.

title: Rolling Kegs
rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6, lying down if you can. 2-8: Flattened. Drink 3, lying down if you can. 9-19: You dive clear. Give 2 to whoever didn't flinch. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4 to whoever didn't flinch.

title: Loose Tap Handles
rules: A foam tap handle bonks you, and you're Thumb Master now. Drink 1, then use it.
dice: Jinx Thumb Master: Whenever the jinxed player puts a thumb on the table, the last to copy drinks 1.

title: Lost Bridesmaids
rules: Two lost bridesmaids have decided you're the groom. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! First dance. Drink 4, then sway with your right neighbor. 2-6: First dance. Drink 2, then sway with your right neighbor. 7-19: You point them upstairs. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

title: The Rat Pack
rules: Three rats in fedoras sing Sinatra for your stool. Sing them a line back, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They do it their way. Drink 4. 2-6: They do it their way. Drink 2. 7-19: You heckle them offstage. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You heckle them offstage. Give 4.

title: Fryer Oil Ooze
rules: Twenty years of fryer oil got up and walked, and it slides clockwise from you. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — It slicks four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: Barback Poltergeist
rules: An invisible barback keeps stacking empty glasses on your head. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: The tower falls. Drink 3. 6-12: You tip him a coin. Stack two empty glasses on someone's head, then give 3.

title: Cobweb Bartender
rules: Read alone what he poured you, then start the clock and mime drinking it. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: A PICKLEBACK. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Low Beam
rules: Your right neighbor holds out an arm as the beam. Limbo under it. Touch it: drink 3.

title: Loose Floorboard
rules: One board in the cellar floor is not like the others. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It springs up and smacks you. Drink 4. 2-8: It springs up and smacks you. Drink 2. 9-19: You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You step over it like a cat. Meow, then give 4.

title: The Stag Party
rules: Eight men in matching shirts, one in a veil, all looking for a ninth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Recruited. Drink 4, then give a best-man toast. 2-6: Recruited. Drink 2, then give a best-man toast. 7-19: You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You send them to the Wine Cellar. Give 4.

title: Grease Trap Horror
rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8, then wash your hands in shame. 2-9: It slurps you in. Drink 4, then wash your hands in shame. 10-19: You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You seal the lid and sit on it. Give 8.

title: The Health Inspector
rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8 and name three things wrong with this room. 2-9: Violation. Drink 4 and name three things wrong with this room. 10-19: You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky pen. Give 8.

title: Keg Mimic Queen
rules: Every keg in the rack opens one eye. The big one in the middle opens two. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The whole rack bites. Drink 8. 2-9: The whole rack bites. Drink 4. 10-19: You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tap the queen. The rack goes quiet. Give 8.

title: The Exterminator
rules: He's here for the rats, and he's decided you count. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sprayed. Drink 8, holding your breath. 2-9: Sprayed. Drink 4, holding your breath. 10-19: You hide him in an empty keg. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You hide him in an empty keg. Give 8.

title: Keg Golem
rules: 800 pounds of tapped lager. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8. 2-8: It sits on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You pull its plug. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: It gets back up, foaming. Chug race with your left neighbor, playing the Golem. Lose: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: The Rat King
rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court by the drain. Kiss the ring, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink. 2-8: The court finds you guilty. Drink 4. 9-19: You dethrone him. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10. · Beat 2: The court is in session. Plead your case to the table for 20 seconds; they vote. Guilty: drink 3. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Royal Decree: Everyone calls the jinxed player Your Majesty. Slip: drink 1.

title: The Landlord
rules: He wants three months' rent. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink. 2-8: Late fee. Drink 4. 9-19: You find a code violation. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10. · Beat 2: He's back with a clipboard for the inspection. Roll 2d6. (2d6 — 2-6: He finds the mold. Drink 4. 7-12: He finds nothing. Give 4.) · Jinx Rent Due: The jinxed player asks the table's permission before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Big Cheese
rules: A rat in cheese armor. Side bets: thumbs up or down on you; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It sits on your snacks. Drink 8. 2-8: It sits on your snacks. Drink 4. 9-19: You eat through the armor. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the armor and the rat. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: It rolls at you, cheese first. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: Flattened. Drink 4. 2-2: Cheese in your hair. Drink 3. 3-3: You dodge. Give 3. 4-4: You take a bite out of it. Give 3. 5-5: It rolls into the wall. Give 4. 6-6: You grate it. Everyone else drinks 2.)

title: The Pipe Organ
rules: Every pipe in the cellar is playing one chord, and it's coming from a face. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You join the chord. Hum for 10 seconds, then drink 8. 2-8: The chord hits you in the teeth. Drink 4. 9-19: You find the off switch. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the off switch. Give 10. · Beat 2: It plays your song. Hum any song; the table has 15 seconds to name it. Nobody does: drink 3. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Organ Voice: The jinxed player sings everything they say. Speaks normally: drink 1.

title: Boxed Wine Golem
rules: A golem of boxed wine, slapping its own bag. Name a boxed wine, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slaps you with the bag. Drink 6, and slap the table twice. 2-6: It slaps you with the bag. Drink 3, and slap the table twice. 7-19: You pop the spout. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the spout and the golem deflates with a sigh. Give 6.

title: Cork Imp
rules: A tiny imp popping corks at eye level and laughing about it. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Right in the eye. Drink 3 with one eye shut. 2-2: Right in the drink. Drink 3. 3-3: You duck. Give 2. 4-4: You cork him. Give 3. 5-5: You cork him and shake him. Give 3. 6-6: You pop one back at him. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Zombie Sommelier
rules: Read alone what he poured, start the clock, then describe it like a wine snob. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: A BOX OF FRANZIA. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: Wine Mom Banshee
rules: Scream 'FIVE O'CLOCK SOMEWHERE!' against your left neighbor. The table calls the quieter: drink 3.

title: Rosé Slime
rules: Pink, sticky, and it says it's not like other slimes. Say something basic, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's exactly like other slimes, and so are you. Drink 6. 2-6: It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 3. 7-19: You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 4.

title: Ghost in the Decanter
rules: It's been breathing for a hundred years. So has the wine. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: It breathes on you. Drink 3 and say 'notes of ghost'. 6-12: You jam the stopper in. Give 3 to the snobbiest drinker here. · Jinx Spooked: Nobody may look the jinxed player in the eye. Caught: drink 1.

title: Barrel Mimic
rules: On three, everyone points at who'd faint first if a barrel grew teeth. Most fingers: drink 2.

title: Corkscrew Crab
rules: A corkscrew crab scuttles under the table, pinching. Last to lift both feet drinks 2.

title: Sangria Sprite
rules: Your right neighbor throws a mimed orange slice. Catch it in your mouth. Booed: drink 3.

title: Vinegar Vampire
rules: A vampire who only drinks from bottles that turned. He's been at yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's right, it turned. Drink 6, make the face. 2-6: He's right, it turned. Drink 3, make the face. 7-19: You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold up a cross made of corkscrews. Give 6. · Jinx Sour Face: The jinxed player pulls a sour face before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Blind Tasting
rules: Eyes shut. Your left neighbor hands you a drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

title: The Flamingo
rules: Stand on one leg with your eyes shut for 10 seconds. Wobble or peek: drink 3.

title: Swirl, Sniff, Lie
rules: Review your drink like a sommelier for 15 seconds. Crack a smile: drink 3.

title: The Toast
rules: Toast your right neighbor, sincerely, for 20 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: Falling Rack
rules: The wine rack tips, one bottle at a time, like dominoes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Domino'd. Drink 6. 2-8: Domino'd. Drink 3. 9-19: You catch the last one. Give 2, and hand someone your 'bottle'. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4, and hand someone your 'bottle'.

title: Merlot Stairs
rules: The stairs are slick with spilled merlot. Stand up, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down on your ass, in red. Drink 4 standing up. 2-8: Down on your ass, in red. Drink 2 standing up. 9-19: Not a drop on you. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You slide down the rail like it's 1999. Give 4.

title: Sulfite Cloud
