rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a wine. The headache hits whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The headache hits. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Cork Mines
rules: The floor is covered in corks. Some of them click. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Pop. Drink 4. 2-8: Pop. Drink 2. 9-19: You tiptoe through. Give 2 to whoever walks loudest. 20-20: Natural 20! You tiptoe through. Give 4 to whoever walks loudest.

title: Fruit Fly Swarm
rules: A cloud of fruit flies off the dump bucket, and they brought friends. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4 with a hand over your glass. 2-6: In your mouth. Drink 2 with a hand over your glass. 7-19: Swatted. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

title: The Book Club
rules: Four women with one unread book. Name a book you pretended to read, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They have notes. Drink 4. 2-6: They have notes. Drink 2. 7-19: You've read it. They scatter. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You've read it. They scatter. Give 4.

title: Cork Goblin
rules: A corkscrew goblin opens a twist-off. Everyone mimes popping a cork; the worst pop drinks 2.

title: Rosé Elemental
rules: Everyone says 'rosé all day' as a threat. The table picks the scariest; they give 3.

title: Tannin Troll
rules: It dries out every mouth in the room. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Your tongue sticks. Drink 3, then say 'tannin' five times fast. 6-12: You out-spit it. Give 3.

title: The Palate Test
rules: Your left neighbor names three wines, one made up. Spot the fake. Wrong: drink 3.

title: Sediment Pit
rules: The bottom of the barrel is a pit, and the pit is all dregs. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You wade through. Drink 4, and chew. 2-8: You wade through. Drink 2, and chew. 9-19: You vault it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You vault it. Give 4.

title: The Gender Reveal
rules: A lost gender reveal party wants you to guess. They have a smoke cannon. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 4. 2-6: Wrong guess, and the cannon goes off. Drink 2. 7-19: You leave before the smoke. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You leave before the smoke. Give 4.

title: The Wine Snob
rules: He swirls, he sniffs, he says you'd like something approachable. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Approachable. Drink 8, and say it's 'fun'. 2-9: Approachable. Drink 4, and say it's 'fun'. 10-19: You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. Give 8.

title: Grape Elemental
rules: Two tons of grapes, stomped into rage. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds. 2-9: Stomped. Drink 4, then stomp your feet for 5 seconds. 10-19: Raisin. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Raisin. Give 8.

title: The Cellar Master
rules: He knows every bottle, and you broke one. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes you sweep. Drink 8. 2-9: He makes you sweep. Drink 4. 10-19: You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You blame the cat. He believes you. Give 8.

title: The Wine Influencer
rules: Two million followers and a ring light. She needs you in her story. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the background. Drink 8, and pose. 2-9: You're the background. Drink 4, and pose. 10-19: You photobomb her. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You photobomb her. Give 8.

title: Count Corkula
rules: He drinks pinot. Yours. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drains your glass. Drink 8. 2-8: He drains your glass. Drink 4. 9-19: A stake through the cork. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Sunlight. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Fangs out. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing the Count. Blink first: drink 3. (Won/Lost) · Jinx The Count: The jinxed player counts their sips out loud, with a cackle. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Cask Queen
rules: She sits on a throne of barrels and judges your palate. Curtsy, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off with your glass. Finish your drink. 2-8: Your palate is basic. Drink 4. 9-19: You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 10. · Beat 2: She demands a toast. Give her one, ten seconds, no ums; the table judges. Fail: drink 3. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Curtsy Court: The jinxed player curtsies before every drink. Forget: drink 1.

title: Château Ghoul
rules: A ghoul in a beret who thinks your wine is beneath you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He sneers you to death. Drink 8. 2-8: He sneers you to death. Drink 4. 9-19: You hand him a White Claw. He dissolves. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! He dissolves into a nice rosé. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: He sniffs your glass with contempt. Roll 2d6 to prove your taste. (2d6 — 2-6: Corked. Drink 4. 7-12: Notes of oak and victory. Give 4.)

title: The Grand Sommelier
rules: Ten feet tall and never wrong. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He spits your drink back in your glass. Drink 8. 2-8: He names your drink, your year and your ex. Drink 4. 9-19: He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! He calls your boxed wine a Bordeaux. Give 10. · Beat 2: Blind tasting: eyes shut, sip a drink the table hands you. Name it wrong: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: The Barrel Room
rules: Two hundred barrels, one of them alive, and they're all rolling. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rolled flat. Drink 8. 2-8: Rolled flat. Drink 4. 9-19: You find the live one and tap it. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf a barrel out. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: The live barrel charges. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: It rolls over you. Drink 4. 2-2: It rolls over your foot. Drink 3. 3-3: You jump it. Give 3. 4-4: You stop it with one hand. Give 3. 5-5: It rolls into the others. Give 4. 6-6: You ride it out. Everyone else drinks 2.) · Jinx Barrel Roll: The jinxed player says 'barrel roll!' whenever anyone rolls. Misses one: drink 1.

title: Bachelor Ghosts
rules: The ghosts of a 1998 bachelor party want one more round. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in the round. Drink 8 and tell your worst wedding story. 2-8: You're in the round. Drink 4 and tell your worst wedding story. 9-19: You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 8.

title: The Ex Wraith
rules: A wraith with your ex's face reads your old texts aloud. Put your phone face down, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It reads the drafts. Finish your drink. 2-8: Every word lands. Drink 4. 9-19: You read theirs back. Give 4 to whoever has the worst ex. 20-20: Natural 20! You read theirs back. Give 8 to whoever has the worst ex.

title: Bone Sommelier
rules: A skeleton in a sommelier's chain rates your drink. Out of ten, it's a two. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Shamed. Drink 8. 2-8: Shamed. Drink 4. 9-19: You pour his on the floor. Rate someone's drink out of ten; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his on the floor. Rate someone's drink out of ten; they drink 8.

title: Leech Swarm
rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor, who plays the leech. Blink or laugh first: drink 3.
dice: Jinx Leeched: Whenever the jinxed player sips, their left neighbor sips too. Neighbor forgets: drink 1.

title: Hex Witch
rules: A witch who reads tarot and your browser history. Cross your fingers, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hexed. Drink 6, and confess your last search. 2-8: Hexed. Drink 3, and confess your last search. 9-19: You flip her table. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You read her history back to her. She vanishes in shame. Give 8. · Jinx Witch's Cackle: The jinxed player cackles before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Vampire Bro
rules: A vampire in a backwards cap who only drinks from frat boys. Say 'bro' twice, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8. 2-8: He makes an exception. Drink 4. 9-19: Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

title: Crypt Crawler
rules: Something with a hundred legs and one beer gut. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It crawls up your shirt. Drink 4, and shake it out. 7-12: You stomp it flat. Give 4.

title: Hungover Mummy
rules: On three, everyone points at who'd still be hungover in three thousand years. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: Karaoke Banshee
rules: Read alone the banshee's song, start the clock, and hum it. The table guesses the song.
dice: Secret: MR. BRIGHTSIDE. · Clock 30 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Lich's Accountant
rules: The lich's intern quizzes you: your left neighbor asks three trivia questions. Miss two: drink 4.
dice: Jinx Question Master: Anyone who answers a question from the jinxed player drinks 1.

title: Tomb of Silence
rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

title: The Bone Tower
rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

title: Backwards Chant
rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

title: The Séance
rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

title: Collapsing Floor
rules: The floor gives way. Last to grab the edge of the table with both hands drinks 2.

title: Dart Wall
rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Darted, in the ass. Drink 6 standing. 2-10: Darted, in the ass. Drink 3 standing. 11-19: You limbo under them. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

title: Fog of Regret
rules: A green fog that smells like the tequila from your 21st. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6. 2-10: Flashbacks. Drink 3. 11-19: You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst 21st. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst 21st. · Jinx Tequila Flashback: The jinxed player shudders at every drink, like it's tequila. Forget: drink 1.

title: Rolling Skull
rules: A giant stone skull rolls down the corridor. Everyone hums the theme while you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6. 2-10: It rolls you flat. Drink 3. 11-19: You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and hum the theme. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and hum the theme.

title: Skeleton Crew
rules: A skeleton bachelorette party wants a shot off a femur. Rattle your bones, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6. 2-8: Off the femur. Drink 3. 9-19: You knock their bones loose. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

title: The Ghoul Choir
rules: Twelve ghouls singing your name, off key. Hum one note with them, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6. 2-8: You join in. Drink 3. 9-19: You conduct them into a wall. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

title: Zombie Roommate
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a chore you skipped. Rent's due on whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: Rent's due. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Gym Ghoul
rules: A ghoul who has skipped leg day for three hundred years. He needs a spotter. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: He drops the bar on you. Drink 4. 7-12: You out-lift a corpse. Flex, then give 4.

title: Skeleton Mariachi
rules: Three skeletons with guitars won't stop until someone dances. The worst dancer drinks 3.

title: Your Own Eulogy
rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

title: The Grabbing Hand
rules: Hands grab from every coffin. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — Four ankles grabbed. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: The Ghost Tour
rules: A ghost tour thinks you're part of the show. They want photos. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them. 2-8: You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them. 9-19: You charge them for the photos. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You charge them for the photos. Give 6.

title: The Crypt Keeper's Mom
rules: She's been waiting up. Do you know what time it is? Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 10, then text your mom. 2-11: Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 5, then text your mom. 12-19: You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hug her. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

title: Death's Intern
rules: Death's unpaid intern is behind on quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filed. Drink 10. 2-11: Filed. Drink 5. 12-19: You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You fill out his forms wrong. He runs, and drops his badge. Give 10.

title: The Bone Dragon
rules: A dragon skeleton with a tiny hat, guarding a pile of bottle caps. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10. 2-11: It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5. 12-19: You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

title: The Banshee Bride
rules: She's been at the altar since 1888, and you look just like him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10. 2-11: She screams your name. Drink 5. 12-19: You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

title: Hangover Hydra
rules: Every head you cut off grows back with a headache. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes regret. Drink 10. 2-11: It breathes regret. Drink 5. 12-19: A head comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Clean through the neck. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: One head left, and it's the one with the migraine. Roll d20. (1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It groans at you. Drink 10. 2-11: It groans at you. Drink 5. 12-19: The last head comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! The last head comes off. Give 8.)

title: The Bouncer
rules: Seven feet of door guy. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He throws you out. Finish your drink. 2-11: He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5. 12-19: You get past one arm. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8. · Beat 2: Arm wrestle your left neighbor, playing the Bouncer. Lose: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx No First Names: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

title: DJ Ossuary
rules: A skeleton DJ, Macarena on loop. Everyone does the Macarena, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drops the bass on you. Drink 10. 2-11: He drops the bass on you. Drink 5. 12-19: You yank a cable. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You steal the aux. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: He drops the beat. Freestyle four lines about the table. Stop or stall: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Lich Lord
rules: His soul's in a shot glass. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink. 2-11: His soul is Jägermeister. Drink 5. 12-19: You smash the shot glass. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You smash the shot glass. Give 8. · Beat 2: He pours his soul into a second shot glass. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: You drink the wrong one. Drink 5. 2-2: You drink both. Drink 4. 3-3: He drinks yours. Drink 3. 4-4: You smash one. Give 3. 5-5: You smash both. Give 4. 6-6: You make him drink his own soul. Everyone else drinks 2.) · Jinx Undead: The jinxed player groans like a zombie before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Ghost of Closings Past
rules: Every bar that ever closed on you, back, and they all want one more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They kick you out of every one. Drink 10. 2-11: They kick you out of every one. Drink 5. 12-19: You pay the last tab. They rest. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy the whole bar. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Name every bar the table has been to together, in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Last Orders: The jinxed player shouts 'Last orders!' whenever a card is put aside. Misses one: drink 1.

title: Gator Junior
rules: Someone flushed a baby gator in 1995. He is not a baby. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Chomp. Drink 8, and do the gator chomp with your arms. 2-8: Chomp. Drink 4, and do the gator chomp with your arms. 9-19: You give him a belly rub. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You give him a belly rub. Give 8.

title: Toilet Mimic
rules: On three, everyone points at who'd use a toilet that licks its lips. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: Hazmat Goblin
rules: A goblin in a hazmat suit who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 8. 2-8: He hugs you, suit and all. Drink 4. 9-19: You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You pull his air hose. He leaves something smoky behind. Give 6.

title: Sludge Bro
rules: The sludge bro wants a flex-off. Everyone flexes; the table picks the weakest flex. They drink 3.

title: Pizza Rat Prime
rules: Slice-off: you and your left neighbor mime eating a slice. Slower, by the table's call: drink 4.

title: The Drain Witch
rules: She brews in the runoff and offers you a sip. Hold your nose, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You sip, and ask for seconds. Drink 6 and say it was lovely. 2-8: You sip. Drink 3 and say it tasted fine. 9-19: You pour it back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8. · Jinx Drained: The jinxed player can only whisper. Too loud: drink 1.

title: Fatberg Spawn
rules: A baby fatberg made of wet wipes and grease. It wants its mom. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6. 2-8: It clings. Drink 3. 9-19: You flush it. Give 4, and make the noise. 20-20: Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8, and make the noise. · Jinx Greasy Fingers: The jinxed player holds their drink with two fingers only. Caught: drink 1.

title: Sewer Mutant
rules: The three-armed mutant arm-wrestles the table, clockwise. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — Four arms pinned. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: A Bitter Turtle
rules: A giant turtle who taught four boys karate and got nothing. He wants a fight. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Nunchucked. Drink 4. 2-2: He lectures you on gratitude. Drink 4. 3-3: You bow first. He respects it. Give 3. 4-4: You flip him on his shell. Give 4. 5-5: You order him a pizza. He cries. Give 4. 6-6: You do a perfect crane kick. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: The Echo Bat
rules: Your right neighbor echoes everything you say for 20 seconds. You laugh first: drink 4.
dice: Jinx Bat Signal: Whenever the jinxed player points at the ceiling, the last to copy drinks 1.

title: The Smell
rules: Hold your nose and describe your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

title: The Pipe
rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

title: The Echo
rules: Talk for 30 seconds while everyone repeats your last word back at you. Stop: drink 4.

title: Rat Race
rules: Race your left neighbor: take a sip, then say 'rat' three times. Slower: drink 4.

title: The Big Flush
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming something to flush. The flush gets whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: Flush. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Loose Grate
rules: The grate under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One leg down a drain. Drink 6 on one leg. 2-10: One leg down a drain. Drink 3 on one leg. 11-19: You hop off. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

title: Swamp Gas
rules: Somebody lit a cigarette. Down here. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Whoomph. Drink 6, and pat out your hair. 2-10: Whoomph. Drink 3, and pat out your hair. 11-19: You dive into the sludge. Give 2 to whoever you blame. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive into the sludge. Give 4 to whoever you blame.

title: The Slime Slide
rules: The floor tilts, and it's greased. Lean back in your chair, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down the slide, face first. Drink 6. 2-10: Down the slide, face first. Drink 3. 11-19: You surf it. Give 2 to the worst surfer here. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf it. Give 4 to the worst surfer here.

title: Roach Conga
rules: The roaches are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6, and lead a conga to the fridge. 2-8: You conga'd. Drink 3, and lead a conga to the fridge. 9-19: You break the line. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

title: The Gator Gang
rules: Three gators in leather jackets, one with a switchblade. Snap your fingers, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your wallet. Drink 6. 2-8: They take your wallet. Drink 3. 9-19: You out-cool them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-cool them. Give 6.

title: The Flushed Goldfish
rules: Read alone what else got flushed, start the clock, then mime it. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: AN ENGAGEMENT RING. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Rat Don
rules: A rat in a fedora says that's a nice drink. Shame if something happened to it. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Something happens to it. Drink 4. 7-12: You make him an offer. Pick someone to kiss your ring or drink 4.

title: Pipe Octopus
rules: Eight arms out of eight pipes, reaching for drinks. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — It steals from four glasses. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: Hold Your Breath
rules: Hold your breath for 20 seconds while the table describes the smell. Gasp early: drink 4.

title: The Manhole Cover
rules: The manhole cover above you is spinning loose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It lands on your foot. Drink 6. 2-10: It lands on your foot. Drink 3. 11-19: You catch it like a frisbee. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch it like a frisbee. Throw a coaster to someone; they drink 6.

title: The LARPers
rules: Four LARPers in foam armor think the sewer is their quest, and you're the orc. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! A foam sword to the face. Drink 6, then growl. 2-8: A foam sword to the face. Drink 3, then growl. 9-19: You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You surrender, and they leave happy. Give 6.

title: Clog Beast
rules: Everything anyone ever flushed, fused into one angry clog. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It backs up on you. Drink 10. 2-11: It backs up on you. Drink 5. 12-19: You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You plunge it. Inside: something shiny. Don't ask. Give 10.

title: Rat Captain
rules: A rat in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Keelhauled. Drink 10, and say 'aye aye, captain'. 2-11: Keelhauled. Drink 5, and say 'aye aye, captain'. 12-19: You take his hat and his ship. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his hat and his ship. Give 10.

title: The Sewer Kingpin
rules: He runs every pipe from here to the river, and he's heard about you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You owe him now. Drink 10. 2-11: You owe him now. Drink 5. 12-19: You flip him. He works for you now. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You flip him. He works for you now. Give 10.

title: The Sewer Siren
rules: She sings from the outflow pipe, and everyone wants to follow. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You follow. Drink 10, and hum her song. 2-11: You follow. Drink 5, and hum her song. 12-19: You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You cover your ears and sing louder. Give 10.

title: The Fatberg
rules: A hundred tons of grease and wipes. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 10. 2-11: It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 5. 12-19: A chunk comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You blast it with a fire hose. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: It rolls back together, bigger. Roll 2d6. (2d6 — 2-7: It absorbs your shoe. Drink 5. 8-12: You flush it. Give 4.) · Jinx Clogged: The jinxed player can't say 'I' or 'me'. Slip: drink 1.

title: Alligator Al
rules: A twelve-foot gator in a bowling shirt. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Al doesn't like your face. Drink 10. 2-11: Al doesn't like your face. Drink 5. 12-19: You bowl him a strike. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Gutter ball, and he's in it. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Al wants your bowling stance. Hold it on one leg while the table counts to 15. Wobble down: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Plumber King
rules: Crowned in a toilet seat with a plunger for a scepter. He demands tribute. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He crowns you with the seat. Finish your drink. 2-11: Plunged. Drink 5. 12-19: You snap the plunger. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You snap the plunger. Give 8. · Beat 2: Kneel and swear fealty to the Plumber King, in one breath, in rhyme. Stumble: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Plunger Hands: Nobody points at anything. Slip: drink 1.

title: Mama Gator
rules: Gator Junior's mother has heard what you did. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She adopts you. Finish your drink, then call her mom. 2-11: She sits on you, gently, for an hour. Drink 5. 12-19: You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You apologize to her face. She weeps. Give 8. · Beat 2: She wants an apology. Apologize to your left neighbor for 15 seconds, sincerely. Laugh: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Pipe Worm
rules: Eighty years in the plumbing, and now it's as long as the city. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It wraps around you twice. Drink 10. 2-11: It wraps around you twice. Drink 5. 12-19: You tie it in a knot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie it in a bow. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: It comes up through the drain behind you. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: It swallows your arm. Drink 5. 2-2: It swallows your drink. Drink 4. 3-3: It hisses. Drink 3. 4-4: You plug it. Give 3. 5-5: You snake it. Give 4. 6-6: You tie it to a pipe. Everyone else drinks 2.) · Jinx Pipe Down: Only the drawer may talk to the jinxed player. Anyone else does: they drink 1.

title: Sommelier Kraken
rules: The kraken sips from four glasses at once. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — Four glasses, four sips. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: Last Orders Siren
rules: A siren sings one more drink, and it's beautiful. Cover your ears, then roll d20 to resist.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You swim to her. Finish your drink. 2-10: You swim to her. Finish half your drink. 11-19: You stuff your ears with limes. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You stuff your ears with limes. Give 10.

title: The Drowned Regular
rules: Read alone his one story, start the clock, then tell it as him. The table guesses what it's about.
dice: Secret: THE ONE THAT GOT AWAY (A FISH). · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: Foam Leviathan
rules: A head of foam the size of a city bus rises out of the taps. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It washes over you. Drink 10, and wear the mustache. 2-10: It washes over you. Drink 5, and wear the mustache. 11-19: You blow the head off. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You blow the head off. Give 10.

title: Piranha Shots
rules: Piranhas in the shots. On three, everyone points at who'd do one anyway. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: Your Merfolk Ex
rules: Your ex is doing amazing. Out-brag your left neighbor for 15 seconds. Table's loser: drink 4.
dice: Jinx Fish Out of Water: The jinxed player gasps like a fish after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Text-Them Eel
rules: An eel whispers: text them. Hand your phone to the left, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You text them. Drink 8, and show the table your last text. 2-10: You text them. Drink 4, and show the table your last text. 11-19: You bite the eel first. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You text the eel instead. It leaves you on read. Give 10. · Jinx Typing...: The jinxed player says 'typing...' before they speak. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Tap Mimic
rules: Pour-off: you and your right neighbor mime a perfect pint. The table picks. Worse pour: drink 5.

title: The Pirate Ghost
rules: A drowned pirate wants his rum back. Say 'arr' like you mean it, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He takes it in blood. Drink 10. 2-10: He takes it in blood. Drink 5. 11-19: You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand him a rum and coke. He's confused, then grateful. Give 10. · Jinx Pirate Tongue: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'arr'. Forget: drink 1.

title: Snorkel Shark
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a fish as you pass. The shark gets whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The shark bites. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: The Drowned Choir
rules: Hum a song until the table names it. 20 seconds. Nobody gets it: drink 5.

title: Rising Water
rules: The water's at your chin. Hold your breath for 30 seconds. Breathe early: drink 5.

title: The Last Round
rules: Last round's on you: name everyone's drink order from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

title: Sea Shanty
rules: Lead the table in a sea shanty. If nobody joins in by the second line, drink 5.

title: Rip Current
rules: The floor is a river now. Swim with your arms, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swept away. Drink 8. 2-12: Swept away. Drink 4. 13-19: You ride it out. Give 3 to whoever's drowning in their drink. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it out. Give 6 to whoever's drowning in their drink.

title: Barnacle Stool
rules: You sat down. Now you can't stand up. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fused to it. Drink 8, and stay seated until your next turn. 2-12: Fused to it. Drink 4, and stay seated until your next turn. 13-19: You rip free, mostly. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You rip free, mostly. Give 6.

title: Undertow Tap
rules: You lean in for a pour and the tap pulls you under. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swallowed. Drink 8, holding your breath first. 2-12: Swallowed. Drink 4, holding your breath first. 13-19: You kick off the bar. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You kick off the bar. Give 6.

title: The Drain Vortex
rules: Someone pulled the plug. Last to spin once in their seat drinks 3.

title: Happy Hour Eels
rules: Two eels in party hats want to buy you a drink. You know what that means. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bitten, twice. Drink 8. 2-10: Bitten, twice. Drink 4. 11-19: You tie them in a knot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie them in a knot. Give 8.

title: Mermaid Bachelorettes
rules: A mermaid bachelorette, out of prosecco. Raise your glass to the bride, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take yours. Drink 8. 2-10: They take yours. Drink 4. 11-19: You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You find them prosecco. They cry. Give 8.

title: The Kelp Bouncer
rules: On three, everyone points at who's never on the list. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: Barnacle Bro
rules: A bro so covered in barnacles he's mostly reef. He wants to arm wrestle. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Reefed. Drink 5. 8-12: You scrape him off the bar. Arm wrestle anyone; the loser drinks 5.

title: Jellyfish Shots
rules: A tray of glowing jellyfish shots drifts past. Grab one. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Stung. Drink 5. 2-2: Stung twice. Drink 5. 3-3: That was a real jellyfish. Drink 5. 4-4: Lime jello. Give 4. 5-5: Blue raspberry. Give 4. 6-6: You grab the whole tray. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Bail Out
rules: Mime bailing water out of the booth for 20 seconds without laughing. Laugh: drink 5.

title: Floating Stools
rules: The bar stools float now, and one is drifting at your knees. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It takes your legs out. Drink 8. 2-12: It takes your legs out. Drink 4. 13-19: You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it like a surfboard. Pick someone to stand; they drink 6.

title: The Fishing Charter
rules: Six dads lost on a fishing charter since Tuesday. Cast an imaginary line, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hooked by the ear. Drink 8. 2-10: Hooked by the ear. Drink 4. 11-19: You point them at the deep end. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You point them at the deep end. Give 8.

title: Sea Hag of Table Six
rules: She's run a tab since the flood, and she's settling it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Settled. Drink 12. 2-13: Settled. Drink 6. 14-19: She pays you in pearls. Hand out 6 like they're pearls. 20-20: Natural 20! She pays you in pearls. Hand out 12 like they're pearls.

title: Shark Bartender
rules: A shark in a vest, polishing glasses with its teeth, is cutting someone off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's you. Drink 12. 2-13: It's you. Drink 6. 14-19: You punch it on the nose. Give 6 to whoever should be cut off. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it on the nose. Give 12 to whoever should be cut off.

title: The Deep One
rules: Something under the bar has been drinking every spill for a century. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It drinks you a bit. Drink 12. 2-13: It drinks you a bit. Drink 6. 14-19: You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour it a pint. It sinks back, happy. Give 12.

title: The Lighthouse Keeper
rules: He hasn't seen a soul in forty years, and he's not letting you leave. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He tells you about the forty years. Drink 12 while someone tells you about theirs. 2-13: He tells you about the forty years. Drink 6 while someone tells you about theirs. 14-19: You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You fix his light, and he lets you go. Give 12.

title: Deep Fryer Demon
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a fried food. The fryer spits on whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The fryer spits. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Line Cook Golem
rules: Your left neighbor calls three drink orders. Repeat them back in order. Miss one: drink 5.
dice: Jinx Behind!: The jinxed player yells 'Behind!' whenever they stand up. Forget: drink 1.

title: Sentient Sourdough
rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10. 2-10: It rises over you. Drink 5. 11-19: You punch it down. Give 5 to whoever's most likely to own a starter. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10 to whoever's most likely to own a starter.

title: Garlic Breath Wraith
rules: Breath-off: hold your breath against your right neighbor. Breathe first: drink 4.
dice: Jinx Garlic Breath: The jinxed player covers their mouth to talk. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Expo
rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Plates everywhere. Drink 5. 2-2: You drop table six's steak. Drink 5. 3-3: You burn your palm on a plate. Drink 5. 4-4: Order up. Give 4. 5-5: Order up, hot and fast. Give 5. 6-6: You run six plates at once. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Food Critic Ghoul
rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10, and give the room a one-star review out loud. 2-10: One star. Drink 5, and give the room a one-star review out loud. 11-19: You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You comp his meal. He tips you his hip flask. Give 8.

title: Cold Room Yeti
rules: On three, everyone points at who ate all the shrimp. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: Dish Pit Horror
rules: The dish pit horror burps up forks, four of them. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — Four forks, four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: The Screaming Chef
rules: A ghost chef who calls everything raw. It's not even food. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 10. 2-10: You're an idiot sandwich. Drink 5. 11-19: You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You serve him something perfect. He goes quiet. Give 10. · Jinx Idiot Sandwich: The jinxed player answers to 'idiot sandwich' only. Answer to their name: drink 1.

title: Rogue Rotisserie
rules: Twelve chickens on a spit, turning, and turning toward you. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Basted. Drink 5. 8-12: You carve your way out. Carve someone a drumstick; they drink 5.

title: Yes, Chef
rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

title: Four Plates
rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

title: The Hot Sauce Wall
rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

title: The Pitch
rules: Pitch the table a new dish in 20 seconds. Fewer than half would eat it: drink 5.

title: Grease Fire
rules: Somebody threw water on it. Everyone yells 'FIRE!', then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8. 2-12: Singed. Drink 4. 13-19: You smother it with a lid. Give 3 to whoever looks hot. 20-20: Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6 to whoever looks hot.

title: Wet Floor
rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds. 2-12: Down. Drink 4, and lie on the floor for 5 seconds. 13-19: You skate it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

title: The Swinging Door
rules: A server bursts through the swinging door. Everyone shouts 'Behind!'; the last to shout drinks 3.

title: The Mandoline
rules: The mandoline is slicing on its own. Hands up, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Thinly sliced. Drink 8. 2-12: Thinly sliced. Drink 4. 13-19: You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You slide the guard back on. Slice the table in half; the other half drinks 6.

title: Raccoon Crew
rules: Two raccoons in chef's hats are stealing the bread. Hide your hands, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your fries too. Drink 8. 2-10: They take your fries too. Drink 4. 11-19: You chase them out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

title: The Brunch Crowd
rules: It's 2 a.m. and a brunch crowd has arrived demanding bottomless mimosas. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bottomless. Drink 8. 2-10: Bottomless. Drink 4. 11-19: You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tell them it's dinner. Their minds break. Give 8.

title: Microwave Ghost
rules: The ghost of every fish ever microwaved at work. Hold your nose, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You were the one who microwaved the fish. Drink 10 and apologize. 2-10: You smell like it now. Drink 5. 11-19: You open a window. Give 5 to whoever brought fish to work. 20-20: Natural 20! You open a window. Give 10 to whoever brought fish to work.

title: The Rat Chef
rules: Read alone the rat's special, start the clock, then describe it like a menu. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: TRUFFLE MAC AND CHEESE. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Ticket Machine
rules: The ticket printer won't stop. Two hundred orders, all for you. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: You're in the weeds. Drink 5. 8-12: Heard. Shout 'Heard!' and give 5.

title: The Order
rules: Repeat back every drink at the table, in order, from memory. Miss one: drink 5.

title: The Hot Pan
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, saying 'hot, hot, hot'. It burns whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: Too hot. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: The Food Truck Guys
rules: Two food truck guys are robbing the walk-in. Shout today's special, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They sell you your own food. Drink 8. 2-10: They sell you your own food. Drink 4. 11-19: You chase them off with a ladle. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chase them off with a ladle. Give 8.

title: The Head Chef
rules: He's thrown a pan at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The pan. Drink 12. 2-13: The pan. Drink 6. 14-19: You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky knife. Give 12.

title: The Butcher
rules: The butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filleted. Drink 12. 2-13: Filleted. Drink 6. 14-19: You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

title: The Owner
rules: He's back from his third divorce and he's doing the books tonight. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He blames you for the books. Drink 12. 2-13: He blames you for the books. Drink 6. 14-19: You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You find the money. He makes you a partner. Give 12.

title: The Celebrity Chef
rules: He has a TV show, a catchphrase and a temper, and you're on. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 12. 2-13: He calls you a donkey on camera. Drink 6. 14-19: You make his dish better. Call someone a donkey; they drink 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You make his dish better. Call someone a donkey; they drink 12.

title: Hop Goblin
rules: Read alone his lecture topic, start the clock, and explain it like a beer bro. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: A HAZY TRIPLE IPA. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Yeast Beast
rules: The yeast beast bubbles toward the table. Everyone puffs their cheeks; first to laugh drinks 2.

title: The Craft Bro
rules: He brewed it himself, in his garage. It has notes of regret. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You taste it. Drink 3. 2-2: You taste it again, to be polite. Drink 3. 3-3: You call it 'interesting'. Give 2. 4-4: You pour it in a plant. Give 3. 5-5: You ask for a lager. He leaves. Give 3. 6-6: You out-brew him on the spot. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Mash Tun Monster
rules: Thumb war with your left neighbor, who plays the mash tun monster. Best of three. Lose: drink 3.

title: The Brewer's Ghost
rules: He died tasting batch one, and wants your opinion on batch two. Sip, nod slowly, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's worse. Drink 6. 2-6: It's worse. Drink 3. 7-19: You lie beautifully. Give 3, then lie to someone about their drink. 20-20: Natural 20! You call it a masterpiece and he finally moves on. Give 6. · Jinx Second Opinion: Anyone who agrees with the jinxed player drinks 1.

title: Foam Ferrets
rules: The foam ferrets scatter. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — They nip four seats. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: Sour Mash Witch
rules: She brews sours, and her mood went sour years ago. Make your sourest face, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Your face stays like that. Drink 6, puckered, while the table watches. 2-6: Puckered. Drink 3 through pursed lips. 7-19: You sweeten her up. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You sweeten her up. Give 6. · Jinx Sour Mash: The jinxed player rates every sip out of ten, out loud. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Keg Ninja
rules: A ninja who fights only with keg taps, and he's good. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Tapped. Drink 3. 6-12: You disarm him. Karate-chop the air, then give 2.

title: Bottle Cap Crab
rules: Flick a coaster to the far edge of the table without it falling off. Two tries. Miss: drink 3.
dice: Jinx Sideways: The jinxed player looks at people only sideways, like a crab. Caught looking straight: drink 1.

title: The Gruit Druid
rules: The druid auctions a cup of 1300s beer. Bid sips clockwise until everyone passes. Top bid drinks it.

title: Name That Brand
rules: Name five beer brands in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 3.

title: The Perfect Pour
rules: Pour a mime pint, narrating like a pro, for 15 seconds. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: The Brewer's Riddle
rules: Your right neighbor names a drink. Sum up its taste in one word. Booed: drink 3.

title: The Bottling Line
rules: Pass an empty bottle around the table and back. Anyone laughs: you drink 3.

title: Bottle Bombs
rules: A whole crate of overcarbonated bottles is going off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Glass and foam. Drink 4. 2-8: Glass and foam. Drink 2. 9-19: You dive behind a vat. Give 2 to whoever got splashed. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive behind a vat. Give 4 to whoever got splashed.

title: The Grain Chute
rules: The grain chute opens right above you. Duck, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Buried in barley. Drink 4. 2-8: Buried in barley. Drink 2. 9-19: You surf it out. Give 2 to whoever would have panicked. 20-20: Natural 20! You surf it out. Give 4 to whoever would have panicked.

title: CO2 Leak
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, all talking in deep voices. The leak hits whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The tank blows. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Hot Wort
rules: The floor is covered in hot, sticky wort. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down you go. Drink 4. 2-8: Down you go. Drink 2. 9-19: You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You moonwalk across. Moonwalk to your seat, then give 4.

title: The Brewery Tour
rules: A tour group in hairnets wants a photo. Strike a pose, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in the brochure. Drink 4. 2-6: You're in the brochure. Drink 2. 7-19: You lead them into a vat. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You lead them into a vat. Give 4.

title: Bottle Gnomes
rules: Two gnomes stealing bottles saw you see them. Whistle innocently, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hush money. Drink 4. 2-6: Hush money. Drink 2. 7-19: You take a cut. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You take a cut. Give 4.

title: Spent Grain Golem
rules: A grain golem wants a bakery. On three, point at who'd bake for it. Most fingers: give 2.

title: Hazy Wraith
rules: A ghost so cloudy you can't see through it. It's 9 percent. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It haunts your palate. Drink 6. 2-6: It haunts your palate. Drink 3. 7-19: You hold it to the light. Give 3 to whoever's hazy right now. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold it to the light. Give 6 to whoever's hazy right now.

title: Forklift Goblin
rules: A goblin learned to drive a forklift. He has not learned to stop. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: A pallet to the shins. Drink 3. 2-2: He reverses over your foot. Drink 3. 3-3: You dodge. Give 2. 4-4: You take the keys. Give 3. 5-5: You wave him into a vat. Give 3. 6-6: You ride the forks. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: Quality Control
rules: Say 'the brewer brewed better beer' five times fast. Trip up: drink 3.

title: The Loose Hose
rules: A wash-down hose is loose and whipping across the floor. Roll d20 to jump it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It wraps your ankles. Drink 4. 2-8: It wraps your ankles. Drink 2. 9-19: You stamp it flat. Give 2 to whoever jumped. 20-20: Natural 20! You stamp it flat. Give 4 to whoever jumped.

title: Homebrew Club
rules: Four beards with growlers want your opinion. All of it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You give it. Drink 4. 2-6: You give it. Drink 2. 7-19: You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You say 'it's very you' and they leave. Give 4.

title: The Brewmaster
rules: Forty years at the kettle, and you just called his stout 'fine'. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes you drink the whole flight. Drink 8. 2-9: He makes you drink the whole flight. Drink 4. 10-19: You call it his best. He weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You call it his best. He weeps. Give 8.

title: Barrel-Aged Horror
rules: Something has been aging in barrel 9 for twelve years. It's out. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's very strong. Drink 8. 2-9: It's very strong. Drink 4. 10-19: You cork it back in. Give 4 to the oldest player here. 20-20: Natural 20! You cork it back in. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

title: The Hostile Takeover
rules: A rival brewery is taking over the taps, one tap handle at a time. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your tap. Drink 8. 2-9: They take your tap. Drink 4. 10-19: You take their tap. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take their tap. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 8.

title: The Head Brewer
rules: She's tasted every batch since 1998, and she hates yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She pours it out in front of you. Drink 8. 2-9: She pours it out in front of you. Drink 4. 10-19: She asks for the recipe. Make one up out loud, then give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! She asks for the recipe. Make one up out loud, then give 8.

title: The Fermenter
rules: A forty-foot fermentation tank, under pressure, and it's angry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It blows its lid on you. Drink 8. 2-8: It blows its lid on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You open the valve. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink it down to the yeast. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: The pressure's building. Hold one note while the table counts to ten. Run out of air: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: King Hop
rules: A hop cone the size of a car. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You call it malty. Finish your drink. 2-8: Too bitter. Drink 4. 9-19: You dry-hop the king. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You dry-hop the king. Give 10. · Beat 2: Describe your drink like a beer snob for 15 seconds. Laugh or stall: drink 3. (Won/Lost)

title: The Beer Snob Lich
rules: Undead, and still telling everyone about Belgian monks. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He lectures you to death. Drink 8. 2-8: He lectures you to death. Drink 4. 9-19: You fall asleep, and it kills him. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-snob him. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Name beers back and forth with your left neighbor, playing the Lich. Stall or repeat first: drink 3. (Won/Lost) · Jinx A Belgian: Nobody says 'beer'; it's 'a Belgian'. Slip: drink 1.

title: The Keg Kraken
rules: Eight arms, each one a tap. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pours down your throat. Finish your drink. 2-8: Eight pours at once. Drink 4. 9-19: You tie its taps in a knot. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie its taps in a knot. Give 10. · Beat 2: All eight taps open at once. Roll 2d6 to shut them. (2d6 — 2-6: Soaked. Drink 4. 7-12: You close the main valve. Give 4.)

title: The Brewery Owner
rules: He just sold to a conglomerate and he's celebrating on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He sprays you with champagne. Drink 8. 2-8: He sprays you with champagne. Drink 4. 9-19: You read the contract. He owes you. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy it back. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: He offers you a job at the brewery. Roll d6 to negotiate. (1d6 — 1-1: Unpaid internship. Drink 4. 2-2: Paid in exposure. Drink 3. 3-3: Free beer for life. Give 3. 4-4: Equity. Give 3. 5-5: You buy the brewery. Give 4. 6-6: You fire him. Everyone else drinks 2.) · Jinx Artisanal: The jinxed player calls everything 'artisanal'. Misses a chance the table spots: drink 1.

title: Freezer Burn
rules: Cold stare-down with your left neighbor. First to blink or laugh loses. Lose: drink 4.
dice: Jinx Brain Freeze: The jinxed player clutches their head and says 'brain freeze' after every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Ice Wraith
rules: A ghost made of frost breathes on your neck. Shiver dramatically, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Chills, the bad kind. Drink 8. 2-8: Chills, the bad kind. Drink 4. 9-19: You breathe back, harder. Breathe on someone's neck; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! It melts into a puddle. Give 8.

title: The Frozen Bachelor
rules: A groom-to-be, frozen mid-shot at his bachelor party. He's thawing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He finishes the shot on you. Drink 8. 2-8: He finishes the shot on you. Drink 4. 9-19: You get him to the church. Pick a best man; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get him to the church. Pick a best man; they drink 8.

title: Frost Giant Bartender
rules: Nine feet tall, ice for hands, and he says you're cut off. Act sober, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's right. You're cut off. Drink 8, then water. 2-8: He pours you a glacier. Drink 4. 9-19: You tip him. He warms right up. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tip him. He warms right up. Give 8.

title: Brain Freeze
rules: Everyone presses a thumb to the roof of their mouth. Last to say 'brain freeze' drinks 3.

title: The Snowman
rules: Read alone who the snowman looks like, start the clock, and describe them. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: SANTA, AFTER A DIVORCE. · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Ice Sculpture
rules: A swan carved in ice, from a wedding nobody came back from. It moves. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pecks. Drink 8. 2-8: It pecks. Drink 4. 9-19: You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chip it into ice cubes. Drop one in someone's drink; they drink 8. · Jinx Frozen: Whenever the jinxed player says 'freeze', the last to stop moving drinks 1.

title: The Mammoth
rules: Mammoth tusk wrestle: link pinkies with your right neighbor and pull. Let go first: drink 4.

title: Hypothermia Hal
rules: Hal is fine. Hal is great, actually. Hal has taken his shirt off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 8. 2-8: Hal gives you his shirt. Drink 4. 9-19: You get Hal a coat. Give 4 to the least-dressed player here. 20-20: Natural 20! You get Hal a coat. Give 8 to the least-dressed player here. · Jinx Chattering Teeth: The jinxed player chatters their teeth before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Margarita Elemental
rules: A slushie with salt on its rim and nothing to lose. Lick your lips, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It brain-freezes you. Drink 8. 2-8: It brain-freezes you. Drink 4. 9-19: You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You lick the salt off. It's defenseless. Give 6.

title: The Shiver
rules: Say the coldest thing you've ever said to an ex, true or not. Nobody winces: drink 4.

title: Frozen Solid
rules: Strike your coldest pose and hold it, dead still, for 15 seconds. Move: drink 4.

title: The Icebreaker
rules: Deliver your best icebreaker to your left neighbor. The table groans: drink 4.

title: The Cold Open
rules: Name a cold drink for every letter of COLD in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

title: The Slippery Floor
rules: Black ice, right where the door used to be. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flat on your back. Drink 6. 2-10: Flat on your back. Drink 3. 11-19: You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 6.

title: The Door Shuts
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, naming a frozen food. The cold gets whoever holds it.
dice: Fuse 12–40 s: The light goes out. Whoever is holding the beer drinks 3.

title: Icicle Drop
rules: The ceiling is all icicles, and you just sneezed. Freeze, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One finds you. Drink 6. 2-10: One finds you. Drink 3. 11-19: You step aside. It shatters. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You step aside. It shatters. Give 6.

title: Tongue on the Pole
rules: Read alone what you licked on a dare, start the clock, and mime it. The table guesses.
dice: Secret: THE ICE MACHINE. · Clock 30 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: The Penguin Gang
rules: Six penguins in tuxes say you're on their ice. Waddle in your seat, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 6. 2-8: Flipper slaps, from all sides. Drink 3. 9-19: You out-waddle them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-waddle them. Give 6.

title: The Frozen Peas
rules: Peas everywhere, and they're organized. Count to five out loud, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Peas down your shirt. Drink 6. 2-8: Peas down your shirt. Drink 3. 9-19: You ice your knee with them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ice your knee with them. Give 6.

title: Popsicle Golem
rules: The golem auctions its last grape popsicle. Bid sips clockwise; top bid drinks it.

title: The Thawed Caveman
rules: A caveman thawed out and wants to know what a phone is. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: He clubs your phone. Drink 4. 7-12: You show him a meme. Grunt at someone; they drink 4.

title: Ice Goblin
rules: The ice goblin juggles cubes around the table. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — Four cubes down four collars. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: Chattering Teeth
rules: Say 'she sells seashells' three times through chattering teeth. Fumble it: drink 4.

title: The Ice Machine
rules: The ice machine is jammed and shaking. Roll d20 before it blows.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 6. 2-10: Ice everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 3. 11-19: You unplug it in time. Give 3, ice cold. 20-20: Natural 20! You unplug it in time. Give 6, ice cold.

title: Ski Lodge Crew
rules: Five people in ski gear who never made the slopes. Say 'après-ski', then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They make you join their shot ski. Drink 6. 2-8: They make you join their shot ski. Drink 3. 9-19: You send them to the hot tub. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You send them to the hot tub. Give 6.

title: The Ice Queen
rules: She rules the freezer, and she has never once let anything go. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She freezes you out. Drink 10. 2-11: She freezes you out. Drink 5. 12-19: You sing at her. She thaws. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You sing at her. She thaws. Give 10.

title: The Abominable Barback
rules: Eight feet of white fur and an ice scoop, and you just asked for no ice. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 10. 2-11: He dumps a bucket on you. Drink 5. 12-19: You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You ask for extra ice. He hands you his scoop. Give 10.

title: The Enforcer
rules: The mob keeps him in here for people who owe. You don't. He doesn't care. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He puts you on ice. Drink 10. 2-11: He puts you on ice. Drink 5. 12-19: You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 10.

title: The Freezer Witch
rules: She keeps her ex in a block of ice, and there's room for one more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're on ice. Drink 10. 2-11: You're on ice. Drink 5. 12-19: You thaw the ex. Give 5 to whoever has an ex on ice. 20-20: Natural 20! You thaw the ex. Give 10 to whoever has an ex on ice.

title: The Walk-in
rules: The walk-in wakes up. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It drops ten degrees. Drink 10. 2-11: It drops ten degrees. Drink 5. 12-19: You unplug it at the wall. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You kick the door off. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: The light's out. Eyes shut, touch the nose of your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Snow Bartender
rules: He pours with snow and he serves only frozen drinks, and he never stops. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You order a slushie. Finish your drink. 2-11: Frozen daiquiri, straight to the brain. Drink 5. 12-19: You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You ask for it neat. He melts. Give 10. · Beat 2: He serves the brain freeze. Roll 2d6. (2d6 — 2-7: Brain freeze. Drink 5. 8-12: You drink it slowly, like an adult. Give 5.) · Jinx Brrr: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'brrr'. Forgets: drink 1.

title: Absolute Zero
rules: The coldest thing there is. It doesn't move. Nothing near it does either. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You stop moving. Drink 10. 2-11: You stop moving. Drink 5. 12-19: You rub your hands together. It's enough. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You light a match. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Freeze while the table counts to 15. Move, laugh or blink: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Chattering: The jinxed player's teeth chatter whenever they speak. Forget: drink 1.

title: The Ice Cream Man
rules: The ice cream van, in a minor key. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You get in the van. Finish your drink. 2-11: Rocky road. Drink 5. 12-19: You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You pay in exact change. He can't cope. Give 10. · Beat 2: He plays the jingle. Name six ice cream flavors in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Frozen Ex
rules: Your ex, frozen at the exact moment you broke up, now thawing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 10. 2-11: They pick up mid-sentence. Drink 5. 12-19: You say you've moved on, and mean it. They shatter. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You both laugh about it. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: They want closure. Say three nice things about an ex in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx As I Was Saying: The jinxed player starts every sentence with 'As I was saying'. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Pigeon King
rules: Coo-off with your left neighbor; the table picks the better pigeon. Worse pigeon: drink 5.

title: The Rooftop DJ
rules: He's playing a sunset set at midnight and he takes requests personally. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: He drops your ringtone into the mix. Drink 5. 2-2: He plays your ex's song. Drink 5. 3-3: An air horn, in your ear. Drink 5. 4-4: You request a banger. Give 4. 5-5: You unplug him. Give 5. 6-6: You take the decks. Everyone else drinks 2.

title: The Wind
rules: Not a monster. Just the wind, forty floors up, and it wants your drink. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 10. 2-10: It takes your hat and your dignity. Drink 5. 11-19: You lean into it like a music video. Hair flip, then give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You lean into it like a music video. Hair flip, then give 10. · Jinx Windswept: The jinxed player flips their hair before speaking. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Seagull
rules: A seagull eyes the table. Last to cover their drink with a hand drinks 3.

title: The Influencer Golem
rules: Built from ring lights, it needs one more take, and you're in the shot. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Take forty. Drink 5. 8-12: You knock over the ring light. Give 5 to whoever's posing.

title: The Neighbor
rules: A man in a bathrobe on the next roof threatens to call. Wave at him, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He calls, and it's your mom. Drink 10, and wave again. 2-10: He calls. Drink 5. 11-19: You invite him over. Pick someone to be the neighbor; they drink 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You invite him over. Pick someone to be the neighbor; they drink 10. · Jinx Indoor Voices: The jinxed player may only whisper. Speak up: drink 1.

title: The Gargoyle
rules: A gargoyle on the ledge, only pretending to be stone. Everyone freezes while you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It drops on you. Drink 10. 2-10: It drops on you. Drink 5. 11-19: You push it off the ledge. Give 5 to whoever's still as stone. 20-20: Natural 20! You push it off the ledge. Give 10 to whoever's still as stone. · Jinx Stone Still: The jinxed player sits perfectly still while anyone else rolls. Moves: drink 1.

title: The Thunderstorm
rules: The sky opens, and nobody brought an umbrella. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Soaked to the bone. Drink 5. 8-12: You dance in it. Everyone dances or drinks 5.

title: The Proposal
rules: Read alone his proposal, start the clock, then act it out. The table guesses the line.
dice: Secret: 'WILL YOU SPLIT AN UBER WITH ME FOREVER?' · Clock 45 s: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

title: Rooftop Raccoon
rules: Guarding the limes: rock-paper-scissors with your right neighbor, best of 3. Lose: drink 5.

title: To the City
rules: Give a toast to the city in 15 seconds, no 'um'. Say 'um': drink 5.

title: Skyline Trivia
rules: Name five cities with famous skylines in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

title: The Slow Dance
rules: 10-second slow dance with your right neighbor, eyes locked. Either laughs: you drink 5.

title: Golden Hour
rules: Give the table your best 'candid' pose. The table votes it fake: drink 5.

title: The Ledge
rules: You lean over for the view, and the railing leans with you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You see your life flash. Drink 8. 2-12: You see your life flash. Drink 4. 13-19: You step back, cool. Give 4 to whoever gasped. 20-20: Natural 20! You step back, cool. Give 8 to whoever gasped.

title: The Sprinklers
rules: The sprinklers come on. Last to cover their head with both hands drinks 3.

title: The Loose Tile
rules: A loose roof tile, slippery from the rain, right under your foot. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You slide. Drink 8. 2-12: You slide. Drink 4. 13-19: You land it like a parkour video. Shout 'parkour!' and give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You land it like a parkour video. Shout 'parkour!' and give 8.

title: The Heat Lamp
rules: On three, everyone points at who'd hog the heat lamp. Most fingers: drink 3.

title: The Rooftop Yoga Class
rules: Twenty people in downward dog want their sunset. Namaste, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They make you join. Drink 8. 2-10: They make you join. Drink 4. 11-19: You namaste out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You namaste out. Give 8.

title: The Pigeon Squadron
rules: Twelve pigeons in a V, on a strafing run. Duck, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8. 2-10: Direct hit. Drink 4. 11-19: You duck behind the bar. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You duck behind the bar. Give 8.

title: The Rogue Drone
rules: A rogue drone buzzes the table, filming. Roll four dice.
dice: 4d6 — It films four bad sides. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

title: The Hot Tub Wizard
rules: A hot tub 'wizard' wants your drink. Hold it close, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's a wizard. Drink 10. 2-10: He's a wizard. Drink 5. 11-19: He's just an old man. Give 5 to whoever believed him. 20-20: Natural 20! He is a wizard, and he likes you. Give 10, and he makes it rain.

title: The Fireworks
rules: Light the fuse. Pass a beer clockwise, each 'ooh' louder. The firework hits whoever holds it.
