title: Paper Planes
rules: Bet on the paper planes the regulars throw off the roof. Cash out or bet again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Yours nosedives. Drink 10. 2-8: Yours nosedives. Drink 5. 9-19: Yours glides. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Yours glides. Give 8.

title: Mimic Planter
rules: A planter that grows prizes until it bites. Cash out or dig again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 10. 2-8: It bites. Drink 5. 9-19: Something sprouts. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Something sprouts. Give 8.

title: Rooftop Dares
rules: The roof plays truth or dare, and the stakes go up. Cash out or go again. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Dared. Drink 10. 2-8: Dared. Drink 5. 9-19: You dare them back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You dare them back. Give 8.

title: Brad Knows the Owner
rules: Brad's cousin knows the owner, so the Quarter-Zips cut in. Drop a bigger name. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 6. 2-7: His cousin really does know the owner. Drink 3. 8-19: The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 3 to the Brad of the table. 20-20: Natural 20! The owner has never heard of Brad. Give 6 to the Brad of the table.

title: Chad's Fake ID
rules: You and your left neighbor (Chad) do 10 seconds of Canadian each. Chad wins: drink 3.

title: We're Together
rules: Thad cuts in, telling the bouncer 'we're together'. You're not. Roll 2d6 to argue.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3. 7-12: The bouncer believes you. Pick someone you're 'together' with; they drink 3.

title: The Group Name
rules: The Quarter-Zips have a group name, a hashtag and matching vests. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They look cooler than you. Drink 6. 2-7: They look cooler than you. Drink 3. 8-19: You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You have a jacket. It beats a vest. Give 6. · Jinx Champ: Everyone calls the jinxed player 'Champ', like Brad does. Slip: drink 1.

title: The Guest List
rules: Brad is on the list. You're on a napkin the bouncer is holding. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: The napkin blows away. Drink 3. 2-2: The bouncer blows his nose on the napkin. Drink 3. 3-3: The napkin holds up. Give 2. 4-4: You're on the list, and Brad's spelled wrong. Give 3. 5-5: You're on the list twice. Give 3. 6-6: Brad's off the list. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Cover Charge
rules: Chad tells the bouncer you're paying for all the Quarter-Zips. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The bouncer believes him. Drink 6. 2-7: The bouncer believes him. Drink 3. 8-19: The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 3, twice, to the same person. 20-20: Natural 20! The bouncer charges Chad double. Give 6, twice, to the same person.

title: The Hand Stamp
rules: Thad licked his hand stamp onto Brad's hand, and they want to try it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It works on you. Drink 6. 2-7: It works on you. Drink 3. 8-19: You wash it off in a puddle. Stamp someone's hand; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You wash it off in a puddle. Stamp someone's hand; they drink 6.

title: Rock, Paper, Brad
rules: Rock, paper, scissors with your left neighbor (Brad), best of three. Lose: drink 3.

title: Chad's Shortcut
rules: Chad found a service elevator and is holding the door shut on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins. Take the stairs and drink 8. 2-9: He wins. Take the stairs and drink 4. 10-19: You squeeze in. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You squeeze in. Give 8.

title: Brad's Group Photo
rules: Brad stops the whole staircase for a group photo, and you're in the way. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: You're cropped out. Drink 4. 7-12: You photobomb it. Everyone poses; the worst pose drinks 4.

title: Thad's Pep Talk
rules: Thad pep-talks the boys. Give your table a better one in 10 seconds. Worse: drink 4.

title: Brad's Leaderboard
rules: Brad keeps a leaderboard of who's had the most tonight, and you're second. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He pulls ahead. Drink 8. 2-9: He pulls ahead. Drink 4. 10-19: You overtake him. Give 4 to whoever's last. 20-20: Natural 20! You lap him twice. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Recruitment
rules: The Quarter-Zips want you in. Thad is holding out a quarter-zip. Roll d20 to say no.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You say yes. Drink 8. 2-9: You say yes. Drink 4. 10-19: You say no and mean it. Make someone zip up; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You say no and mean it. Make someone zip up; they drink 8. · Jinx One of the Boys: The jinxed player ends every sentence with 'bro'. Slip: drink 1.

title: The Last Table
rules: The Quarter-Zips want your table. Brad is already sitting on it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Brad sits on you. Drink 8. 2-11: Brad sits on you. Drink 4. 12-19: You tip the table, gently. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tip Brad off it. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Brad's still on it. On go, race Brad (your left neighbor) to sit on it. Lose: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: A Toast to the Boys
rules: Thad is giving a toast about 'the boys', eleven minutes in. Roll d20 to cut him off.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You cry at it. Finish your drink. 2-11: It's moving, somehow. Raise a glass and drink 4. 12-19: You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You raise a glass mid-sentence, and it's over. Give 8. · Beat 2: Your turn: toast the Quarter-Zips, sincerely, for ten seconds. Laugh: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: Chad's Last Round
rules: Chad ordered the last round, for the boys only. Intercept it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 8. 2-11: He drinks yours in front of you. Drink 4. 12-19: You carry the tray to your own table. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You carry the tray, and Chad tips you. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Chad grabs the tray back. Roll 2d6. (2d6 — 2-7: He spills it on you. Drink 4. 8-12: It's yours. Give 4.) · Jinx For the Boys: The jinxed player says 'for the boys' before every drink. Forget: drink 1.

title: Brad's Venmo Request
rules: Brad has Venmo-requested everyone here $14.50 for 'vibes'. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You accidentally pay it. Drink 8. 2-11: You accidentally pay it. Drink 4. 12-19: You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You request $15 back for 'better vibes'. Give 8. · Beat 2: Pay Brad (your left neighbor) back in compliments: three in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Request Sent: The jinxed player says 'I'll Venmo you' when given a drink. Forgets: drink 1.

title: The Dance-Off
rules: The Quarter-Zips call a dance-off. The whole bar is watching. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Brad does the worm. You can't follow that. Drink 4. 2-2: You pull something. Drink 4. 3-3: Thad dips you. You let him. Drink 4. 4-4: You do the robot, and mean it. Give 4. 5-5: You moonwalk out the door and back. Give 4. 6-6: Everyone in the bar joins your dance. Everyone else drinks 2. · Beat 2: Round two: you and Thad (your left neighbor) dance, no music. The table votes. Thad wins: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Boys' Tab
rules: Brad closes his tab and puts it on yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Signed. Drink 8. 2-11: Signed. Drink 4. 12-19: You sign it 'Brad'. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You sign it 'Brad'. Give 8. · Beat 2: The bartender wants a signature. Roll d6. (1d6 — 1-1: You sign it. Drink 4. 2-2: You sign it twice. Drink 4. 3-3: You tip 30% on it. Drink 3. 4-4: You sign it 'Brad'. Give 3. 5-5: You sign it 'Chad'. Give 4. 6-6: You sign it 'The Boys'. Everyone else drinks 2.)

title: Thad's Uber
rules: Thad ordered one ride for everyone, and it's a Prius. Roll 2d6 for a seat.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: You're in the trunk. Drink 4. 8-12: Front seat. Give 4. · Beat 2: Shotgun: you and Thad (your left neighbor) call it. The table says who was first. Thad: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Rematch
rules: Chad wants a rematch for the queue. He's been stretching since the door. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's been training. Drink 8. 2-11: He's been training. Drink 4. 12-19: Same result as the door. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Chad is so impressed he buys your table a round. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Thumb war with Chad (your left neighbor), best of three. Lose: drink 4. (Won/Lost)

title: The Peephole
rules: A slot opens. Invent a password in 5 seconds and sell it. Table says no: drink 3.

title: Flapper Fran
rules: Fran challenges you to a Charleston. Do 5 seconds of it, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Two left feet. Drink 6. 2-7: Two left feet. Drink 3. 8-19: The room applauds. Pick a dance partner; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The room applauds. Pick a dance partner; they drink 6.

title: Bathtub Gin
rules: A bathtub full of homemade gin, and a ladle. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It tastes like a radiator. Drink 3. 2-2: You go blind for a minute. Drink 3. 3-3: Smooth, somehow. Give 2. 4-4: You ladle out a round. Give 3. 5-5: You find the still's off switch. Give 3. 6-6: You bottle it and sell it. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Proprietor
rules: A bootlegger, dead since Prohibition, still running the room. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 8. 2-9: He pours you the bathtub special. Drink 4. 10-19: You tip off the feds. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy the place. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: He wants the password. Make one up and say it like you mean it; the table votes. No: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Prohibition: Nobody says the word 'drink'. Slip: drink 1.

title: Bottle Service
rules: A server brings a sparkler bottle and a bill for $900. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: You sign it. Drink 3. 7-12: It was for the next table. Give 3 to whoever ordered it.

title: The Influencer
rules: Take the most flattering photo of the table in 10 seconds. They hate it: drink 3.

title: The Bodyguard
rules: Six-five, an earpiece, no neck. He wants to see your wristband. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! No wristband. Drink 6. 2-7: No wristband. Drink 3. 8-19: You walk in like you own it. Give 3 to whoever's VIP. 20-20: Natural 20! You walk in like you own it. Give 6 to whoever's VIP.

title: The Promoter
rules: He's put your name on a list. You don't know which list. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the promoter now. Finish your drink. 2-9: The bad list. Drink 4. 10-19: You're on the good list. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You're on the good list. Give 8. · Beat 2: Get on the list: spell your full name backwards in ten seconds. Fail: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Talk to My Agent: Nobody speaks to the jinxed player except through someone else. Slip: drink 1.

title: The Accountant
rules: He's found a discrepancy in the books, and it's you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're the discrepancy. Drink 6. 2-7: You're the discrepancy. Drink 3. 8-19: You find his discrepancy. Give 3 to whoever owes you money. 20-20: Natural 20! You find his discrepancy. Give 6 to whoever owes you money.

title: The Security Camera
rules: Freeze like a statue for 15 seconds while the table tries to crack you. Move: drink 3.

title: The Safe
rules: The combination is somebody's birthday. Guess whose and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: The alarm goes off. Drink 3. 2-2: A dye pack. Drink 3, blue. 3-3: Cracked it. Empty, but you look cool. Give 2. 4-4: Petty cash. Give 3. 5-5: Petty cash and a bottle. Give 3. 6-6: It was the owner's birthday. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Manager
rules: He needs you to come in on Saturday. He's not asking. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're working Saturday. Drink 8. 2-9: You're working Saturday. Drink 4. 10-19: You quit, loudly. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get his job. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Performance review: name three of your strengths in ten seconds, no laughing. Fail: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Per My Last Email: The jinxed player starts every sentence with 'Per my last email'. Forget: drink 1.

title: The Card Sharp
rules: He deals you in with a smile you don't like. Roll 2d6 for your hand.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Two pair. His is better. Drink 3. 7-12: Full house. Give 3.

title: The Tell
rules: Tell two truths and a lie. Anyone spots the lie: you drink 3.

title: The Dealer
rules: She's dealing from the bottom of the deck and smiling about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Busted. Drink 6. 2-7: Busted. Drink 3. 8-19: You catch her. Deal someone in; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch her. Deal someone in; they drink 6.

title: Big Mike
rules: He has never lost a hand, and he plays with real money and fake teeth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Big Mike takes the pot. Drink 8. 2-9: Big Mike takes the pot. Drink 4. 10-19: You call his bluff. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the pot and his teeth. Everyone else drinks 3. · Beat 2: Poker face: the table has ten seconds to make you laugh. Laugh: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx Poker Face: The jinxed player may not smile. Caught: drink 1.

title: The Arm Wrestle
rules: Arm-wrestle your right neighbor, best of one. Lose: drink 3.

title: The Ref
rules: A ref with one rule: there are no rules. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He calls it on you. Drink 6. 2-7: He calls it on you. Drink 3. 8-19: He raises your hand. Blow the whistle on someone; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! He raises your hand. Blow the whistle on someone; they drink 6.

title: The Undercard
rules: The undercard fighter is warming up, on you. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Jab, jab, hook. Drink 3. 2-2: Headlock. Drink 3. 3-3: You slip the jab. Give 2. 4-4: You counter. Give 3. 5-5: You knock him out of the ring. Give 3. 6-6: The crowd lifts you up. Everyone else drinks 1.

title: The Undefeated
rules: He has a belt, a mouthguard and a grudge he can't remember starting. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You go through a table. Finish your drink. 2-9: Down for the count. Drink 4. 10-19: You take the belt. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the belt. Give 8. · Beat 2: Round two: arm wrestle your left neighbor. Lose: drink 4. (Won/Lost) · Jinx First Rule: Nobody talks about the basement. Mention it: drink 1.

title: Flooded Stairs
rules: Last to say 'glub' when a floor opens drinks 1. Traps cost a heart more. Take a smoke bomb.

title: Happy Hour
rules: Two for one: whoever drinks picks someone to drink with them. Every heal heals a heart more.

title: Running a Tab
rules: Say 'on my tab' when handed a drink, or drink 1. Two hearts short, with a shield and a draught.

title: The Lock-In
rules: Ask before leaving your seat, or drink 2. Bosses take a hit more. Take a die and a shield.

title: Cargo Shorts
rules: You wore cargo shorts: drink 3. One more satchel slot, and a draught in a pocket.

title: Butterfingers
rules: Anyone who drops anything drinks 2. One satchel slot fewer, but two more hearts.

title: Blood Moon
rules: Howl at every monster; last to howl drinks 1. Fights cost a heart more, but two more hearts.

title: Lefty Night
rules: Everyone drinks with their off hand all crawl. Caught using the other: drink 1.

title: Karaoke Night
rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of anything. Refuse: drink 2.

title: The Regulars
rules: Everyone shouts the drawer's name when they draw, like a regular. Forget: drink 1. Two more hearts.

title: Thin Walls
rules: Whisper the whole crawl; too loud, drink 1. Trials cost a heart more, but heals heal one more.

title: The Pregame
rules: Everyone drinks 1 at the door. Start a heart short, with a loaded die and a shield.

title: Payday
rules: Everyone got paid today. Gambles and relics roll 2 higher. Start a heart short.

title: Designated Driver
rules: The DD packed a draught. One more satchel slot, but bosses cost a heart more.

title: Friday the 13th
rules: Bad luck and good luck: natural 1s land on a 2 too, natural 20s on a 19.

title: Trivia Night
rules: Before each boss the drawer answers a trivia question, or drinks 2. Trials cost less, traps more.

title: Brad's Birthday
rules: Brad's birthday: the Quarter-Zips are feral. Ambushes cost a heart more. Take a shield.

title: Open Bar
rules: A wedding upstairs has an open bar. Take two draughts, but one satchel slot fewer.

title: Name Tags
rules: Everyone picks a fantasy name at the door and answers only to it. Wrong name: drink 1.

title: Lucky Penny
rules: A lucky penny on the stairs. Every d20 fight rolls 1 higher, but start two hearts short.

title: Barbarian
rules: Rage first. Questions never. +2 to boss d20s. Traps hurt 1 more. Wears Rusty Greataxe.

title: Rogue
rules: Has your wallet. +2 to trap and relic d20s. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Smoke Bomb. Wears Shiv.

title: Cleric
rules: Blesses every drink, loudly. Every heal heals 1 more. Wears Holy Vestments.

title: Wizard
rules: Reads the menu like a spellbook. −2 max hearts. Starts with 2 Loaded Dice. Wears Pointy Hat.

title: Bard
rules: Brought a guitar. Nobody asked. +1 max heart. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Wears Battered Lute.

title: Paladin
rules: Sworn to guard the table's drinks. +1 max heart. Starts with a Coaster Shield. Wears Holy Mace.

title: Ranger
rules: Tracks the bar by smell. +2 to monster d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more. Wears Bar Darts.

title: Drunken Monk
rules: Starts drunk. Gets better. −1 max heart. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2. Wears Hip Flask.

title: Necromancer
rules: Has died twice tonight already. −3 max hearts. Starts with a Second Wind. Wears Bone Wand.

title: Alchemist
rules: Has a flask for every flask. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with 2 Healing Draughts.

title: Warlock
rules: Sold their soul for a better seat. −3 max hearts. +2 to every battle d20. Wears Hellfire Hoodie.

title: Bouncer
rules: Checked your ID twice. +2 max hearts. Ambushes hurt 1 less. Wears Heavy Flashlight.

title: Bartender
rules: Knows everyone's order. +1 max heart. +1 satchel slot. Starts with a Bar Tab and a Healing Draught.

title: Mercenary
rules: Will fight anything for a drink. +1 to monster d20s. +3 to elite d20s. Wears Kevlar Vest.

title: Druid
rules: Smells like moss. Talks to the plants. +1 max heart. +2 to trap d20s. Wears Pet Ferret.

title: The Plus-One
rules: Nobody invited them. −3 max hearts. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. Wears Borrowed Blazer.

title: The Intern
rules: Unpaid, sadly. −2 max hearts. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2. −2 satchel slots. Wears Visitor Lanyard.

title: The Mimic
rules: A very confused chest. −5 max hearts. −1 to every battle d20. +2 satchel slots. Wears Its Own Lid.
